articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Network-based Enhancement for Super-Resolution Reconstruction in Division of Focal Plane Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Advancements in technology have refined polarization imaging systems for realtime, multi-directional imaging. However, their super-pixel design leads to instantaneous field of view (IFoV) issues. Addressing this, a super-resolution method using the Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Network (SRGAN) has been introduced. This method efficiently recovers high-quality details from low-resolution polarimetric images. Using PSNR and SSIM metrics, this method demonstrates enhanced performance over existing techniques.

articleTitle: Multi-Value Missing Processing Method of Integrated Modular Avionics System Operation Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The Integrated Modular Avionics system has high integration and complex functions. Its working status needs to be monitored in real time during operation. During flight, the external environment is harsh and changeable, and there may be mechanical vibration, electrical noise, series mode interference, and common mode interference, temperature changes and other factors affect the sensor, resulting in the inability to obtain part of the data measured by the sensor and a multi-value missing problem. This paper is based on the multi-value missingness of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) temperature data of a certain type of aircraft's IMA system. Through working mechanism analysis, the nonlinear regression analysis method is used to perform regression analysis on the CPU temperature and CPU utilization data, so as to realize the estimation of CPU temperature data missing value, improve the quality of IMA system operating status data and provides guarantee for subsequent anomaly detection, fault diagnosis and other work.

articleTitle: Feature Enhancement Method for Multimodal Nighttime Pedestrian Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Nighttime Pedestrian Detection in Low-Light Conditions poses a challenging task, as previous processing methods often introduced noise and limited model generalization due to the low image quality in low-light conditions. This study presents a feature enhancement algorithm tailored for multimodal nighttime pedestrian detection, harnessing the advantages of infrared and visible light data. Our approach utilizes an adaptive weight fusion algorithm and a spatial detail module for multimodal fusion and spatial detail feature extraction, respectively, to accomplish the nighttime pedestrian detection task. Experimental results demonstrate that our method, compared to the baseline algorithm, achieves performance improvements of 3.3%, 11.9%, and 4.5% on the LLVIP dataset.

articleTitle: Research on High Performance Cooling Method and Structure of Magnetic Resonance Gradient Coil
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Gradient coil temperature is an important issue in the design and construction of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanners. Due to the use of resistive materials to drive high current related Ohmic heating, tightly spaced gradient coil windings can cause temperature hotspots within the system and strongly affect the image resolution and coil performance of magnetic resonance imaging. This paper presents a three-dimensional modeling of a gradient coil with a hollow water-cooled structure, and conducts heat transfer simulation analysis of the gradient coil using COMSOL Multiphysics finite element software. Firstly, the point data of the coil winding is obtained using the boundary element flow function method. Then, use Solidworks to create a 3D model. Finally, the three-dimensional model of the gradient coil is imported into COMSOL for multi-physical simulation and analysis, including magnetic field, solid heat transfer, and laminar flow. This article simulates the temperature distribution of gradient coils with hollow water-cooled structures at different flow rates, and compares the results with gradient coils without hollow water-cooled structures. Comparing the heat transfer simulation results of two sets of gradient coils, it was found that the gradient coil with a hollow water-cooled structure has better heat dissipation performance, and the flow rate is positively correlated with the heat dissipation performance of the coil. This has important reference significance for the cooling structure design of practical gradient coils.

articleTitle: AGV Structure Design for Transporting Photovoltaic Panels
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The full name of AGV is Automatic Guided Vehiele, which is an unmanned automatic tractor guided along a programmed path by a magnetic or laser guided device, controlled by a computer, car, and servo driver. It has the advantages of simple operation, stable and reliable operation, and safe and reliable operation. Currently, it is widely used internationally in various industrial fields, such as manufacturing, logistics, and defense and military industries. AGV has become one of the hotspots in the development of intelligent transportation systems. This article first analyzes the mechanical transmission scheme, and then analyzes and calculates the selection of servo motors and reducers to drive the designed AGV car. Laser navigation is used to avoid obstacles. The small car designed in this design is driven by connecting the drive motor to the reducer and then to the wheels. Analyze and verify the main components of shafts, bearings, and couplings to avoid excessive waste and failure; Finally, the battery of the selected car has reached sufficient capacity and will be recycled for use the next day.

articleTitle: Optical Coherence Tomography System based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the widespread adoption of laser welding technology in modern manufacturing, the online and real-time inspection of welding quality has become an urgent issue in the manufacturing sector. Addressing this challenge, this study introduces and establishes an Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) online inspection system based on deep neural network algorithms, aiming to automate and real-time assess the quality of laser-welded workpieces. Initially, we set up a hardware architecture for OCT, specifically designed for laser welding quality inspection. Subsequently, we developed a model based on deep neural networks, capable of automatically extracting and identifying welding defect features from OCT images. To train and validate this model, we collected a vast array of laser welding OCT images and conducted in-depth experimental research. Through extensive experimental validation, our system demonstrated outstanding performance in the task of welding defect detection, with its accuracy and efficiency significantly surpassing traditional image processing techniques. Importantly, the system can process a large amount of online welding data in realtime, offering a practical solution for online welding quality inspection on production lines. This research not only provides a fresh perspective on online inspection of laser welding quality but also serves as a valuable reference for real-time quality control technologies in related fields.

articleTitle: Investigation and Prediction on Characteristics of Damping Metamaterials Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The vibrations caused by traffic loads, machineries, wind loads have become increasingly serious. It is imperative to find new methods for reducing and controlling these vibrations. Thus, in this paper, a damping metamaterial consisted of three components is proposed. The forbidden gap characteristics are investigated in detail. In order to rapidly acquire the features of forbidden, a prediction network model is established based on machine learning. The vibrations can be effectively attenuated in forbidden gap. The prediction network model fits the data well.

articleTitle: A Simulation Method of Radar Cross Section based on FEKO
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Radar Cross Section (RCS) is the most important amplitude characteristic of target electromagnetic scattering. In this paper, the definition and classification of RCS are given firstly. Then, the simulation calculation method of static RCS based on FEKO is studied. Finally, the static RCS simulation calculation of typical standard body is carried out. The simulation results show that the average error between measured data and simulation results of standard body is less than 3dB, and the proposed simulation calculation method can meet the requirements of electromagnetic simulation calculation.

articleTitle: Designing a Standardized Process for Automotive Cyber Security Incident Management
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the development of automotive networking and intelligence, the cyber security issues faced by intelligent connected vehicles have become increasingly prominent. Automotive cyber security has become a significant concern in the industry. Incident management, as an essential part of the vehicle's entire lifecycle, encompasses incident detection, analysis, and response. It plays a critical role in ensuring cyber security for both automobile manufacturers and component suppliers. Therefore, it is necessary to establish a standardized management process. This paper presents a general process for managing automotive cyber security incidents, based on ISO/SAE 21434 “Road vehicles-Cybersecurity engineering” and R155 “Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to cyber security and cyber security management system”. The proposed process serves as a guide for relevant enterprises to adapt it to their specific business scope, characteristics, practical experience, and potential types of cyber security incidents they may encounter. Furthermore, it encourages continuous improvement and refinement based on their own development, aiming to address cyber security incidents in a standardized and efficient manner while minimizing their negative impact.

Author Keywords: Automotive cyber security, incident management, standardized process, ISO/SAE 21434, R155

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection from System Logs based on Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Modern computer systems are mostly distributed and have a complex and large structure. Therefore, it's important that the system operates safely and effectively. Fortunately logs record the state of system operation, so logs play an important role in system anomaly detection. It is a proven method to use deep learning methods for system anomaly detection. In this paper, we improve the log parsing method and use the Long Short-Term Memory neural network in combination with the Transformer deep neural network to model the log data into log sequences for anomaly detection. The experimental results show that the improved log parsing method is significantly more efficient and the F1 scores of this paper's model are significantly better than other models.

articleTitle: Research on Series Fault Arc Identification Method Based on Wavelet Transform and Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Series fault arc is not found easily and releases large quantities of heat for a short time. The sustained combustion and generation of high temperatures by the arc can pose a threat to the safe operation of the power system, which is easy to cause fire. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out the research of detecting series arc faults located on lowvoltage AC lines. A series arc identification algorithm based on wavelet transform and empirical mode decomposition are proposed in this paper. Firstly, the electrical characterization of faulty arcs is analyzed for three typical low-voltage load types. After that, the wavelet transform is used for the preliminary screening of suspicious arcs. Then, the actual values of the mode components IMF are obtained based on complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD), which are matched with the theoretical values of IMF of the confirming arcs by use of the derivative dynamic time regularization algorithm. Finally, arc identification is completed by calculating the degree of similarity of the above two sets of signals. Experiments have shown that the method can accurately detect series arc faults.

articleTitle: Six-DOF Manipulator Application in the Durability Testing System of the Flushing Device
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As the leading product of sanitary ware, the toilets have become the main water appliance, which play very important role in daily life. The toilets are used frequently which must have a certain life cycle. The durability testing system of flushing device based on Six-DOF manipulator is developed. The test results prove that the durability testing system improves the detection accuracy of sample, improves the operation stability of equipment and the detection efficiency, and expands the scope of application of the tested sample.

articleTitle: Prediction of Performance Degradation Trends of Turnout Machine Based on Autoencoder and TCN Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In response to the frequent failures of turnout machines, which make it difficult for on-site staff to predict these failures, this paper proposes a method for predicting the performance degradation trend of turnout machines based on Autoencoder (AE) and Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). First, time-domain, frequency-domain, and time-frequency features of the turnout machine's action power data are extracted to construct a feature vector set that reflects the degradation process of the turnout machine. KPCA is utilized to remove redundant information present in multiple-domain features. A Healthy Indicator (HI) is constructed based on the AE network. Subsequently, a performance degradation prediction model based on TCN is built to achieve the prediction of the turnout machine's degradation trend. The effectiveness of the method is verified using on-site datasets. The outcomes demonstrate that KPCA successfully reduces the feature set from 22 dimensions to 2 dimensions, retaining 81.33% of the information from the original optimal feature set. Additionally, the approach of constructing a healthy indicator based on the AE network proves to be effective. The generated healthy indicator accurately reflects the degradation process of the turnout machine's performance over time. The model developed using the TCN algorithm accurately forecasts the performance degradation of the turnout machine. This model outperforms prediction models constructed based on LSTM networks and GRU networks in terms of prediction accuracy. This method is generally applicable and has practical guidance for on-site maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on GIS Topology Modeling of Distribution Network Based on Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the expansion and increased complexity of distribution networks, establishing a distribution network line model library has become an important means of accurately analyzing and simulating the distribution network. This article proposes a topology modeling method based on data fusion and GIS platform for distribution networks. By collecting and constructing a multi-source database of distribution network lines, combined with data fusion and dynamic routing methods, the rapid modeling of the distribution network topology model and the generation of update strategies are achieved. The article introduces how to construct the model on the GIS platform and proposes a network graph display optimization scheme. By combining hierarchical display and spatial indexing technology, the rendering processing speed is improved, providing effective support for distribution network planning and operation optimization.

articleTitle: Design of a Small-Scale Laser-Triggered Pseudo-Spark Switch
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: A small-scale laser-triggered pseudo-spark switch has been designed. The switch has a volume of 30 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, an effective electrode volume of 8 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, a maximum operating voltage of 8 kV, and can be triggered using 532 nm lasers. The impact of laser energy and hydrogen pressure on the switch's delay and jitter has been investigated. Experimental results indicate that for a 532 nm laser, the laser energy threshold is 1.2 mJ. Furthermore, increasing hydrogen pressure can reduce the switch's delay time and jitter time, ultimately achieving jitter of less than 1 ns. This switch exhibits excellent triggering stability, addressing electromagnetic interference issues during switch operation, and holds promising applications.

articleTitle: Loradrop: An Efficiency Optimization Method for Lora
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The computational cost of large-scale pre-trained models based on Transformer is prohibitively high, with demanding training requirements that are often beyond the capabilities of consumer-grade GPUs for fine-tuning on downstream tasks. Recently, the widely adopted fine-tuning method, LoRA, addresses these drawbacks by decomposing and replacing matrices within the model, along with freezing a significant portion of model parameters to reduce the number of trainable parameters. In this paper, we propose the LoRADrop method, which further reduces the number of LoRA modules in lower Transformer layers based on the LoRA approach, aiming to decrease the training cost of model fine-tuning. We conducted comparative experiments on eight tasks from the GLUE benchmark, including full-model fine-tuning, LoRA fine-tuning, and LoRADrop fine-tuning methods. Our results demonstrate that the LoRADrop method significantly accelerates training speed (speed improvement ranging from 12% to 40%) while achieving comparable or even superior task performance compared to the LoRA method in multiple downstream tasks.

articleTitle: Zero Trust Unified Access Control based on Multi-Scenario Fusion Training
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The basic idea of federated learning is to aggregate the local model parameters of all participants to obtain a global model, which is more general and has better performance. However, the existing federated learning suffers from the problem of a unique model, where all participants train their local models based on the same global model, which is not suitable for multi-scenario training. In this paper, we propose a new decentralized federated learning model, which moves the aggregation work from the central server to each participant's local device, enabling joint training of the model without sharing the datasets across different scenarios. Moreover, the model parameters are aggregated based on model similarity, which enables end-to-end feature learning for multi-scenario fusion and thus achieves unified access control for zero-trust on end devices. This paper applies the proposed model to the identification of abnormal terminal traffic and tests the recognition performance of the model using the NSL-KDD dataset. The results show that the proposed model achieves a five-classification recognition accuracy of up to 92.76<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> on the NSL-KDD dataset, demonstrating good recognition performance.

articleTitle: LiDAR-Camera Fusion: Guided Vehicle-to-Aircraft Sensing with Cooperative Vehicle Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Many airplanes need a guidance vehicle to direct them to specific parking spaces after landing at the airport. In order to enhance airport intelligence and safeguard airport safety, this task requires a high degree of precision in the guidance vehicle's perception of the aircraft. However, in the current research, there are fewer applications of vehicle-road cooperative sensing in airport scenarios, which makes it difficult to exploit the potential roadside sensing capability. In this work, we propose a vehicle-road cooperative perception method, called VICOD, which completes the decision-level fusion and outputs the fused detection frames under the assumption of spatio-temporal alignment. It is based on the vehicle-side detection outcomes generated by the improved AVOD algorithm and the road-side identification results generated by the IA-SSD algorithm. We use the KITTI dataset to validate the associated method. The results of the studies demonstrate that the technique can successfully increase the guided vehicle's sensing accuracy and range to the back of the aircraft.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Rail Transit Fault Diagnosis Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As urban rail transit enters a new era of digitalization and intelligence, the pressure on safe operation is increasing day by day, which also puts forward higher requirements for the daily operation, maintenance and fault diagnosis of urban rail transit. At the same time, the subway wireless communication system has a complex structure and a large number of equipment, which makes it more difficult to quickly diagnose and accurately troubleshoot train faults. This article performs fault diagnosis on the urban rail train-to-ground wireless communication system based on Bayesian network. Through data mining of fault descriptions, solutions and vehicle equipment fault record tables in the vehicle-to-ground wireless communication system, we can find the correlation between faults and generate a fault sample set, and establish a fault tree model based on the mined information. Through Bayesian The network realizes wireless communication system fault diagnosis and contributes to the construction of smart urban rail operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Active Noise Control System Based on Hybrid Fixed Filter Method and FxLMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Traditional real-time active noise control (ANC) has been widely used to reduce environmental noise, usually using the filtered-x least mean square (FxLMS) algorithm to adjust the control filter coefficients. However, the adaptive algorithm converges slowly, cannot achieve stable noise reduction effect immediately, and may diverge under the interference of transient noise. Therefore, this paper proposes a method that combines fixed filter coefficients with FxLMS algorithm to overcome the problem of slow convergence speed of FxLMS algorithm and improve the robustness of adaptive algorithm. The algorithm selects pre-trained control filter coefficients according to the spectrum of noise source, and at the same time, FxLMS algorithm updates the control filter coefficients with the filter coefficients as initial values. Experimental results show that this algorithm can effectively reduce convergence time and improve robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Installation and Control Technology of Uhv Main Equipment Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The quality of UHV main equipment installation directly affects the safety of grid operation, and at this stage, there are problems such as incomplete data, insufficient quality control, and low degree of intelligence. This paper takes digital twin technology as the core, establishes the model architecture of intelligent installation of UHV main equipment, formulates various quality index systems of main equipment, combines the transformation of monitoring equipment with IOT technology, and develops an intelligent control system to realize the comprehensive perception, control and optimization of the installation process of UHV main equipment. This research can greatly improve the quality level and efficiency of the installation process of UHV equipment and save the cost of substation main equipment installation.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Strategy A * Path Planning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: For the purpose of path planning of UAVs in complicated 3D environments, an improved A * algorithm is proposed. Firstly, in order to ensure the safety of UAVs in the path searching process, the UAV's own power consumption and flight altitude limitations are taken into account, while the evaluation function of adaptive weights is introduced to improve the efficiency of the algorithm; secondly, in order to solve the problem of storage explosion of traditional 3D A* algorithms in complex environments, a modified In order to solve the problem of storage explosion of traditional 3D A* algorithm in complex environment, we propose to modify the search direction and storage method, which reduces the storage space by 30.4% and 98.82% respectively, and the running time by 43.99% and 99.63% respectively; finally, we solve the problem that the traditional 3D A* algorithm has too many inflection points leading to the search path is too long through the deletion of the redundant nodes, and the length of the path is shortened by 11 % after the improvement; the improved algorithm is analyzed through the comparison of simulations. The improved algorithm can be analyzed by simulation and comparison, and it can be seen that the improved algorithm occupies less storage space, runs faster, and the path length is shorter, which is obviously better than the traditional 3D A* algorithm.

articleTitle: Underwater Imaging Using Low Rank Matrix and Sparse Representation for Oil Pipeline Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Due to the critical importance of underwater pipeline integrity, particularly in the oil and gas transportation sector. This paper addresses the significance of applying low-rank matrix and sparse representation theories in the context of underwater imaging, with a primary focus on oil pipeline inspection. By comparing the effects of three algorithms on image processing, the superiority of the Structured Low-Dimensional Representation (SLDR) algorithm is demonstrated. The research aims to enhance the accuracy and quality of underwater images, ensuring the safety and integrity of subaqueous pipeline systems.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Electric Field Distribution Characteristics of Main Equipment Fittings in 750kV Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to effectively achieve corona control and precise noise reduction in various 750kV substations in the northwest region, this article conducts a study on the surface electric field distribution characteristics of the main equipment fittings of the 750kV substation. Through on-site investigation and observation of corona discharge conditions in multiple 750kV substations, a simulation calculation model for the surface electric field distribution characteristics of typical bay main equipment in 750kV substations was established. Select the three most severe moments of electric field distribution distortion in the 750kV substation, namely the peak voltage moment of A, B, and C three-phase operating values, and load the equipment in each phase according to the actual operating conditions to analyze the entire field electric field distribution of the 750kV substation. The results of this study can provide a theoretical research basis for solving the corona discharge problem of the main equipment in the 750kV substation.

articleTitle: Electric Field Simulation Study of Zero-Value Defects in 110kV Transmission Tower Insulator Strings
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Ceramic insulators are susceptible to the influence of complex environmental factors during long-term operation, easily leading to zero-value insulators and causing flash over or breakdown phenomena. In severe cases, these issues can result in power outages, grid failures, and even fires, short circuits, and equipment damage with significant consequences. In this paper, the 110kV straight-line cathead tower insulator string is selected as the simulation object, and the finite element calculation method is employed to analyze the spatial electric field measurement results under different operating conditions. The research findings indicate that the outer surface of ceramic insulators exhibits an asymmetric “U”-shaped distribution of the spatial electric field. Additionally, it was observed that the spatial electric field variation caused by degraded insulators decreases as the measurement distance increases. Considering the three-dimensional spatial electric field, the degradation of insulators has a close correlation with the position of the degraded insulator within the insulator string. When a zero-value insulator is present at the high voltage end of the insulator string, the electric field value of the entire string is significantly higher than the normal value. Furthermore, the impact of multiple degraded insulators in succession has the most significant effect on the rate of spatial electric field change. The research results provide theoretical support for the detection of substandard insulators, offering valuable references for further improving and optimizing insulator design, maintenance, and management.

articleTitle: Design of Airborne Bus Communication Platform based on Isomorphic Dual Redundancy Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low reliability of airborne bus communication platforms under limited volume, weight, power consumption, and computing power in airborne environments, the design scheme of the airborne bus communication platform was completed by demonstrating the software and hardware architecture of isomorphic dual redundancy channels. This design scheme first analyzes the usage scenarios and requirements indicators of the airborne bus communication platform, standardizes the design process based on the analysis indicators, and then designs a hardware architecture based on isomorphic dual redundancy channels according to the requirements and application environment of the design scheme. Finally, it focuses on the data interaction characteristics between the airborne product and the upper computer, Complete the design of dual redundancy data intelligent control software from the perspective of dual channel data flow and channel fault switching. Simulation examples show that this solution effectively solves the problems of high fault reporting rate and excessive resource redundancy in traditional equipment, and significantly improves the reliability of massive data transmission and reception in airborne environments.

articleTitle: Design of Web-Based Monitoring System for the External Target Facility
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The External Target Facility (ETF) in Cooler Storage Ring(CSR) of the Heavy Ion Research Facility in Lanzhou (HIRFL) is a critical platform for the Institute of Modern Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences. It is instrumental in conducting experimental research on nuclear matter properties and radioactive ion beam physics. In order to meet the needs of researchers who cannot go to the experimental area to monitor data, this article designed a monitor system based on the Web technologies and Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System(EPICS). The system outlined in this paper comprises a Web server and a front-end Vue framework. It effectively monitors the Process Variable (PV) data from slow-control devices within the ETF and offers functionalities such as login verification and permission management. The proposed design approach also allows application in other platforms beyond the ETF.

articleTitle: Sub-Synchronous Oscillation Suppression Strategy with Additional Air-Gap Magnetic Chains
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The application of series capacitor compensation technology often triggers the phenomenon of sub-synchronous control interaction (SSCI) in doubly-fed wind farms, and since the traditional strategy has the problems of poor control performance, low economy, and cumbersome and complex structure, this paper proposes an additional air-gap magnetic chain suppression strategy to improve the positive damping of the system and inhibit the oscillation dispersion. The method utilizes the SOGI structure to extract the subsynchronous oscillatory components in the stator current and rotor current of the doubly-fed wind turbine generator (DFIG), and then utilizes a quasi-resonant controller to carry out closed-loop control of the subsynchronous air-gap magnetic chain so as to achieve the purpose of suppressing the SSCI. Finally, this paper builds a time-domain simulation model of doubly-fed wind farm based on MATLAB/SIMULINK to verify the feasibility of the additional air-gap magnetic chain suppression strategy of sub-synchronous oscillation. The results demonstrate that the additional air-gap magnetic chain suppression strategy can improve the positive damping of the system under different wind speeds and series compensation degrees, thus suppressing the dispersion of subsynchronous oscillations in doubly-fed wind farms.

articleTitle: Research on Detection of Moldy Corn Kernels Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Corn plays an important role in many fields, but the level of intelligent detection for moldy corn is low. This article proposes a method for identifying moldy corn kernels based on machine vision. First, the image is processed, and then the MSR method with color restoration in the Retinex image enhancement algorithm is used to enhance the image. The threshold is set in the HSV space, and the moldy corn kernels are segmented through morphological processing. The two processing results are combined through logical AND operation to obtain the result. The final detection result shows that the probability of effectively recognizing moldy corn kernels can reach around 95%. This proves that the algorithm proposed in the article can efficiently and quickly detect moldy individuals in corn kernels, providing technical support and theoretical basis for the future development of intelligent detection of moldy individuals in corn.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Image Classification Technology Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In this paper, the core of image classification and recognition technology, i.e. the principle of convolution operation and image feature extraction, is combed in detail, and the storage form of images in the computer is shown. On this basis, the basic principle and method of image feature extraction with the help of deep convolutional neural network is analyzed, and the programming is implemented. The author verified the classification effect of the established model by using 3000 image data. The experimental results show that the application effect of image classification technology (image recognition speed and accuracy) is closely related to the quality and learning rate of the deep convolutional neural network model.

articleTitle: Detecting Phishing Websites by Using a Hybrid Method of Page Content and Formal Concept Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the increasing threat of phishing websites, how to judge whether a website is a phishing website has become a research hotspot. However, there are few researches on phishing websites corresponding to a specific kind of website. In order to detect phishing websites of specific websites, this paper proposes a new method. This method carries out TF-IDF analysis on a given website, extracts some words to represent the website, and constructs a formal concept lattice on this basis. After TF-IDF analysis, some words are extracted from the website to be detected and compared with each concept in the formal concept lattice. Therefore, we can pick up an optimal concept, identify phishing websites and inform the owners of specific websites. Experiments show that this method can effectively identify phishing websites.

articleTitle: Application of Augmented Reality in Thermistor Thermal Response Test of Satellite
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper reviews the traditional thermistor thermal response test of satellite in AIT process. In order to improve efficiency and quality of thermistor thermal response test, a test method based on AR technology is designed. This method enables closed-loop testing without the use of wireless devices in the test hall. It used an augmented reality device to greatly improve the identification efficiency of a large number of the thermistor codes and positions on the spacecraft, and only one person can complete the spacecraft thermistor thermal response test.

articleTitle: Finite Element Model Simulation of Cavity Partial Discharge in Solid Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Partial discharge modeling and simulation can help to deeply understand the physical process behind partial discharge and the damage law to insulation performance, to determine the characteristic parameters affecting the partial discharge behavior, and to mine the correlation information between the partial discharge information and the insulation state of the equipment. This is of great significance for improving the theoretical basis of the partial discharge on-line monitoring system of power equipment to maintain the safe operation of the power system and prevent equipment failure. This paper establishes a new finite element model by the finite element analysis method to describe the partial discharge phenomenon of spherical cavities in a homogeneous solid medium. Based on this model, the influence of various applied stresses on partial discharge activity is studied. The simulation results collect and analyze the phase, number of discharges, and amplitude of discharge activity, and the changes in average discharge, total discharge per cycle, average discharge per cycle, maximum discharge amplitude, and minimum discharge amplitude with time and voltage phase are counted. Finally, according to the analysis of simulation results, the characteristic parameters with significant influence on partial discharge activity are identified.

articleTitle: Rapid Detection of QR Code Based on Histogram Equalization-Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile internet, the popularization of 5G, and the popularization of smartphone terminals, the coverage of Wi Fi is expanding, and the use of QR codes in outdoor advertising is also increasing. Especially in the prevention site and tracking of COVID-19. The detection and recognition of QR codes affect people's daily lives. In the process of using QR codes, the image is too dark, the camera shooting is not clear, and the QR code in the entire image is too small, which restricts the fast and accurate detection of QR codes. This article proposes a method for quickly recognizing and detecting two-dimensional codes using the histogram equalization YOLOv5 algorithm. Histogram equalization can improve the QR quality of images, and then use YOLO v5 for QR detection and recognition. The implementation shows that this method can effectively submit the accuracy and efficiency of QR code recognition, and improve people's experience in using QR codes.

articleTitle: Electric Field Simulation of 550kVGIL Linear and Corner Elements
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Three pillar insulators are important supporting components in GIL, and their insulation performance determines the performance of GIL transmission lines. This article uses the finite element method to model and simulate the electric field of the GIL linear and corner elements, with a focus on calculating the composite field strength, tangential field strength, and normal field strength distribution on the surface of the three pillar insulator legs in the GIL linear and corner elements. Research shows that in a linear unit, the maximum surface field strength of the insulator leg is 29.2kV/cm, and the tangential field strength is 7.62kV/cm. The maximum surface field strength of the insulator in the corner unit is 24.26kV/cm, the tangential field strength is 10.62kV/cm, and the normal field strength is 24.82kV/cm. The field strength at the insulator insert is 42.67kV/cm. This provides a foundation for the structural optimization of the three pillar insulators in the future.

articleTitle: Evaluation of New Energy Accommodation Capacity of Power System Based on Time Series Production Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The main factors limiting the grid-connected accommodation of new energy are theoretically studied from the standpoint of new energy accommodation. As assessment indices of the grid connection's capability for new energy accommodation, the amount of abandoned electricity, the rate of abandoned electricity, and the number of hours of power generating utilization are utilized. An annual time series production simulation model is established that takes into account the grid connection of large-scale new energy generation while taking into account factors like system peaking capacity, power balance, system reserve capacity, conventional unit output, system transmission capacity, and energy storage constraints, among others. The accommodation simulation is performed using a power grid from a new energy enrichment region in northwest China as an example. The calculations' outcomes attest to the validity of the suggested approach. On this basis, the installed capacity of new energy is used as a variable in a sensitivity analysis to explore the limit of new energy accommodation capacity under the current power supply planning and assess the rationale of the new energy development planning. In the end, a quantitative analysis of the promotion impact of flexibility measures on utilization of new energy is conducted, and new ideas for power system energy planning are suggested.

articleTitle: Research on Structure and Key Parameter Modeling of Excitation Device for Magnetic Flux Leakage Detection of U-Shaped Hanging Ring
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The U-shaped hanging ring of power fittings is the most stressed component in the transmission line fittings. The bottom elbow of the U-shaped hanging ring often produces wear and damage defects due to friction contact, resulting in accidents such as line disconnection and shedding. As a ferromagnetic material, the defect of U-shaped hanging ring of electric power fittings can be detected by magnetic flux leakage detection method, but there are few studies on the excitation device of U-shaped hanging ring, a special structure. In order to optimize the design of U-shaped hanging ring magnetic flux leakage detection excitation device and improve the sensitivity and accuracy of magnetic flux leakage detection in U-shaped hanging ring defect detection, this paper proposes an improved half-ring excitation structure based on the traditional excitation structure. Based on COMSOL simulation software, the U-shaped hanging ring magnetic flux leakage detection model of power fittings is established, and the influence of different excitation structures on the magnetization effect of U-shaped hanging ring and the influence of different excitation parameters on the external spatial magnetic field distribution of U-shaped hanging ring are explored. It is found that the improved half-ring excitation structure significantly enhances the magnetization effect of the U-shaped hanging ring, and the magnetic field characteristic signal at the defect is obviously distorted. Therefore, the designed excitation device model has high practicability in the magnetic flux leakage detection of U-shaped hanging ring.

articleTitle: An Optimized Query Scheme for Geographic Information Data Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Geographic information data finds extensive applications at both the national and societal levels. The decentralized nature of blockchain technology facilitates trust among participants, eliminating the need for centralized institutions and offering a reliable database for many-to-many sharing of geographic information data. This data can be categorized into two parts: geographic data and their corresponding metadata. As of now, mainstream blockchain systems do not support the storage of excessively large data volumes on the blockchain. In contrast to the query functionality of traditional databases, existing blockchain systems are unable to directly query data fields within transactions, and their query methods are limited. This paper introduces a geographic information data query optimization solution based on blockchain technology. It involves the combined storage of both data parts using IPFS and blockchain, reducing on-chain storage redundancy, especially for metadata characteristics. Additionally, it incorporates Bloom filters and inverted index into a tamper-proof index structure, enhancing support for multi-keyword queries within the MPT tree. With this structure, users can access multiple relevant information, optimizing the query efficiency on the blockchain.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Video Analysis System of Power Scene Anomaly Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As a branch of computer image vision technology, video intelligent analysis has been widely used in the field of security, which plays an important role in operation monitoring, fault analysis, early warning automation and information processing in the power grid industry. In order to improve the low efficiency of the artificial patrol mode of the existing substation video surveillance system, this paper designs an intelligent video analysis system for power scene anomalies based on convolutional neural network. Firstly,the system architecture is analyzed. Secondly, the original surveillance video material is extracted. Then, the video cloud storage platform is used for storage. At the same time, the hidden danger behaviors are classified and analyzed and marked. Finally, the proposed method is applied to feature extraction, model training and application analysis to realize video intelligent early warning analysis. Based on convolutional neural network algorithm, the video analysis ability is further improved, which greatly improves the quality and efficiency of substation video monitoring, and has a certain promotion prospect.

articleTitle: Designing Hardware Systems for Embedded Soft PLCs in Engineering Machinery Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The construction machinery industry faces the challenge of outdated programmable controllers (PLCs) with limited versatility. To meet the evolving needs of this industry, adherence to the IEC61131-3 standard has become essential. This standard revolutionizes controller technology, providing five unified programming languages and enabling cross-compatibility among controllers. This paper explores the significance of open embedded soft PLCs that adhere to this standard, aiming to enhance controller versatility, meet market demands, and increase the international market share of construction machinery. The research delves into the hardware system design of a universal controller for construction machinery, addressing power protection, voltage conversion, clock circuit, JTAG interface, input modules, pulse volume acquisition, output modules, and communication interfaces. Through detailed design processes and schematic representations, this research contributes to the advancement of construction machinery controller technology.

articleTitle: A Novel Ellipse Object Detection Network Based on Adaptive Point Set
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Object detection is a crucial task in the field of computer vision, and circular objects are commonly encountered in various industrial and transportation domains. However, in real-world scenarios, captured objects often appear as ellipses due to the influence of shooting angles. Hence, ellipse object detection has broader applicability compared to circular object detection. In recent years, ellipse detection algorithms have mainly focused on traditional methods, and applying deep learning techniques to ellipse object detection remains challenging. In this regard, we propose a novel ellipse detection network that combines a verification branch with a regression branch, along with an improved feature point evaluation method. This allows the rotation-based object detector to better learn and represent the characteristics of ellipses. Compared to existing algorithms, our trained model demonstrates superior performance on limited datasets, excelling in multiple evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Design of High Pressure Pipeline Electromagnetic Flowmeter
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Due to the limitation of traditional electromagnetic flowmeter in high pressure, a nested electromagnetic flowmeter is proposed in this thesis. The sealing requirements of the electromagnetic flowmeter under high pressure environment are realized by embedding the sealing sleeve, lining sleeve and lower screw ring in the welded assembly of the center pipe and using Otype sealing ring. The design scheme can improve the measuring accuracy and service life of the electromagnetic flowmeter under high pressure environment, and provides an effective solution to meet the measurement requirements of industrial ultra-high pressure flowing liquid.

articleTitle: High Speed Motion Compensation for ISAR Imaging Based on Matched Filter Parameter Adjustment and Entropy Minimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: High speed motion of space target will lead to the extension of the range profile, which is unfavorable for ISAR imaging processing. In this paper, a high speed motion compensation method based on matched filter parameter adjustment and entropy minimization is proposed for intermediate frequency direct sampling (IFDS) data. Firstly, the effect of high speed motion on IFDS data is analyzed. Then, parameter adjustment of the matched filter is designed to achieve high speed motion compensation and pulse compression. Finally, we model the motion of the target in the imaging processing time as a polynomial, and the particle swarm algorithm (PSO) is used to iteratively search the motion parameters. Simulation experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Laser Processing Path Generation Method Based on Stereolithography Surface Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a new laser processing method for triangular mesh surfaces. In order to solve the efficiency problems of the hierarchical bounding box method in curved surface layering intersection, this method proposes to use the direction of intersecting lines and the adjacency relation of surfaces to achieve faster layered detection of triangle-to-triangle intersection. In order to solve the deformation problem of parameter mapping in tool path generation, this method proposes a circular unfolding method to get a plane, and the contour parallel tool path planning method is used to fill the unfolded plane. At last, the curved surface processing path is generated by inversely mapping. The effectiveness of laser processing method is verified by a faster intersection comparison experiment and two triangular mesh surface cases studies.

articleTitle: Intelligent Unmanned Control System for Local Ventilation Fan in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The local ventilation fan in the mine undertakes the task of ventilation underground and is an important electrical and mechanical equipment for ensuring safe production in the mine. It needs to maintain long-term, continuous, safe, and reliable operation. This paper mainly designs an intelligent monitoring system for the local ventilation fan in the mine based on Siemens S7-1200 PLC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">]</sup> and SCADA<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">]</sup>. The architecture of the system is studied, and a control system for the local ventilation fan based on PLC is designed<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">]</sup>. The functions, hardware circuits, and software programs of the system are designed. The human-machine interface is used to monitor the local ventilation system of the mine in real-time, allowing for visual observation of the operation of the local ventilation fan in the coal mine. Based on the detection and warning functions of the system, timely adjustments can be made to the ventilation system, greatly improving the safety of the local ventilation system in the coal mine. It also enhances the level of intelligent management of the local ventilation fan equipment, which is beneficial for improving the economic efficiency of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Optimization of Suspension Active Control System Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Based on the improved genetic algorithm, this paper realizes the design and optimization of active suspension control system, aiming at improving the performance of automobile suspension system. Firstly, this paper introduces the working principle and importance of active suspension control system. Secondly, the design idea of improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the limitations of standard genetic algorithm. The improved genetic algorithm is used to optimize the weighting coefficient of the controller and find the optimal solution. In the process of algorithm implementation, appropriate performance evaluation indexes are selected to reflect the optimization effect of suspension. At the same time, the actual road environment and conditions of suspension system are considered to simulate the actual road conditions as much as possible. Finally, through simulation experiments and comparative analysis, it is proved that the improved genetic algorithm is effective and feasible in improving the performance of suspension active control system, which provides a new optimization design idea and method for automobile industry.

articleTitle: Construction of Electrolytic Aluminum Platform based on Industrial Internet Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The emergence of the industrial internet has made a huge historical breakthrough in the original industrial production methods. Among them, industrial internet platforms can be described as the “backbone” of industrial internet, but how to combine industrial internet platforms with specific industries and maximize their advantages is also a problem worth paying attention to. This article combines the industrial internet with the electrolytic aluminum industry, taking the industrial internet platform as the foundation and the electrolytic aluminum industry as the research object. By integrating the two, an intelligent and digital electrolytic aluminum platform based on the industrial internet platform is constructed to solve the many shortcomings of the traditional electrolytic aluminum industry.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Fault Diagnosis Technology based on Multivariate Correction of Fluorescence Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The traditional insulating oil condition detection mostly adopts Dissolved Gases Analysis (DGA) technology, which faces serious shortcomings such as long detection period, inability to respond quickly in real time, and low sensitivity when the amount of dissolved gases is small or there are no dissolved gases. In order to solve the above problems, based on the change mechanism of fluorescent substances in faulty oil and the principle of multivariate calculation, a fluorescence multivariate correction transformer fault diagnosis technology is proposed, to establish and optimize the fluorescence multivariate correction model of insulating oil for qualitative and quantitative diagnosis of faults. Taking three commonly used insulating oils as research samples: Karamay oil, Nynas oil Nytro Libra (NL without additives) and Nynas oil Nytro Gemini (NG with additives). The fluorescence spectral data of the oil samples are collected and analyzed under different fault conditions, and the optimal excitation wavelengths and spectral preferred bands are determined. The threshold ranges for the rate of change of the aromatic hydrocarbon concentration are analyzed to complete the qualitative diagnosis, then to construct polynomial fitting models of the aromatic hydrocarbon concentration and fault degree, to complete the fault quantitative diagnosis. The proposed method provides theoretical basis and research foundation for realizing online realtime monitoring, and also lays the foundation for subsequent making the multivariate correction coefficients into filters, realizing the model hardware, and greatly reducing the detection cost.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Novel Flexible Rudder with Zero Poisson's Ratio Honeycomb
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Smooth and continuous variable camber airfoils have significant advantages in improving aerodynamic performance, but the existing schemes are usually complex and expensive. To address this problem, a novel flexible rudder combining a flexible structure and the traditional actuating mechanism is proposed. In the rudder, a zero Poisson's ratio honeycomb with cosine-type beams is employed as the flexible structure, which is driven by an embedded distributed skeleton to realize the deflection of the seamless rudder. The deflection of the rudder surface was simulated by finite element analysis in ANSYS. Results show that the rudder surface can always maintain an excellent aerodynamic shape within the deflection range of ±25°; the maximum stress in the honeycomb is 32.092MPa under initial design, which meets the structural safety. The maximum deflection of the rudder varies from 12.09° to 24.63° when the honeycomb thickness decreases from 1mm to 0.8mm, under the output torque of 1.3Kg·cm. In addition, the weight of the rudder surface is reduced by 31.58% compared with the traditional rudder surface, which effectively reduces the flight burden. The proposed flexible rudder is expected to promote the high-performance and low-cost application of seamless flexible airfoils.

articleTitle: Short-Term Electrical Load Forecasting Based on the DeepAR Algorithm and Industry-Specific Electricity Consumption Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper employs the DeepAR algorithm to conduct short-term electrical load forecasting specifically tailored for three distinct regions: commercial, residential, and industrial areas. Central to our model is a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) structure rooted in Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) units. Our research transcends mere single-region predictions, delving into the interplay between different regions and its consequent impact on forecasting. Through meticulously designed experiments, we ascertain the significant influence of cross-regional dependencies on prediction accuracy. Furthermore, by leveraging statistical tools like correlation coefficients, we embark on an in-depth analysis of historical data, aiming to unravel the underlying interactivity mechanisms. The findings suggest that, when accounting for cross-regional dependencies, the DeepAR model can accurately capture the dynamic variations of electrical loads, thereby offering targeted and efficient recommendations for the power supply strategies across various regions.

articleTitle: An Investigation of the Correlation Between the Resonant Frequency of Cantilever Beams with Their Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Vibration signals are particularly important in the field of machinery condition monitoring and troubleshooting. However, highly sensitive sensors are susceptible to interference in harsh environments and are costly. Therefore, mechanically boosting vibration signals has a big potential to increase monitoring accuracy. It is interesting to design free-end cantilever beam constructions that can resonate at particular frequencies by changing their diameters. In this paper, the intrinsic frequency is simulated by varying the dimensions of cantilever beam height, length, width, and thickness using the finite element method. In the end, SPSS was applied to determine that there was a substantial link between the thickness of the cantilever beam and the intrinsic frequency of the system, yielding a correlation value of <0.001. The modest correlation coefficients between the intrinsic frequency and the height of the support bar, cantilever beam length, and width are 0.765, 0.396, and 0.813, respectively, which showed a little link with the intrinsic frequency. Signal amplification structures with specific resonance frequencies obtained by changing the dimensions of the cantilever beams are particularly suitable for the collection of vibration signals in harsh environments.

articleTitle: Experimental and Numerical Investigation on the Influence of the Internal Caldding Layer in Single Hat-Stiffened Composite Panels Under Axial Compressive Load
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Hat-stiffened panels are widely utilized in modern aircraft fuselage structures. Moreover, debonding between stiffener and skin is the dominant cause of failure. experimental and numerical methods are employed to study the internal cladding layer's effect on the bearing capacity for Hat-Stringer-Stiffened composite panels in this paper. Three types of panels are researched. One type of specimen had no cladding layer in the stiffener, and the others had a fully cladding layer and a half-cladding layer, respectively. Numerical calculations are conducted by using ABAQUS software. Cohesive elements are employed to simulate the debonding of the skin-stiffener interface. A progressive damage model on basis of Hashin's failure criteria is adopted to simulate the damage process of the composites. The estimated buckling loads and ultimate failure loads agreed well with the experimental data, which validated the accuracy of the calculation approach developed in this study. The evolution of skin-stiffener damage is presented, and the influence of the cladding layer is discussed in this paper. The results indicate that the hat stiffener's cladding layer can improve the buckling load and ultimate capacity of the Hat-Stringer-Stiffened composite panels.

articleTitle: Efficient Reflection Coefficient Prediction and Optimization for Printed Inverted F Antenna Based on Graph Neural Networks Patch Antenna Design and Optimisation by GNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper introduces AntennaN et, a novel machine learning model that employs a convolutional neural network architecture to facilitate the design and optimization of microstrip antennas. Historically, antenna design has been a complex and time-consuming task that involves extensive simulations and high engineering costs. However, this model can accelerate and even automate the design process significantly. Tests indicate that AntennaN et enhances the speed of antenna simulation by a factor of one million compared to commercial electromagnetic (EM) simulators. Additionally, the model can be employed to automatically optimize antenna design based on the predetermined performance metrics. The model was successfully tested in the context of designing a rectangular microstrip antenna. The experiment yielded a design that satisfied the goals in less than one second.

articleTitle: Reliable Collaboration Chain Mining for Workshop Manufacturing Services Based on Non-Local Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to extract reliable collaboration patterns from the historical data of workshop manufacturing services, the improved graph convolutional network (GCN) method is proposed, and the non-local feature aggregation strategy is introduced to improve algorithm stability. According to the collaboration mechanism of manufacturing service and the actual manufacturing process, the historical manufacturing service collaboration chain is constructed as graph data, where the nodes are manufacturing services, and the edges are service collaborations. GCN is then employed to process the graph of manufacturing service collaboration chains systematically and efficiently, considering the manufacturing service attribute, service collaboration attribute, and collaboration chain topology are considered. Reliability is quantified as the ability to produce sufficient qualified products within a specified time as the label. Experiments with the data of a printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing enterprise verify the validity and feasibility of the proposed method. The proposed method is stable and has high precision.

articleTitle: A Single Image Rain Removal Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a single image rain removal algorithm based on deep learning to address the long-standing issues of incomplete rain removal, background blur, and detail loss in image rain removal tasks. Firstly, this article constructs a deep feature extraction network based on the encoder decoder architecture to extract deep level detailed feature information. Secondly, a lightweight feature extraction subnet is proposed, which is first used for shallow feature extraction and then embedded into the deep feature extraction network to fully mine and capture deep level rain pattern information, thus achieving better image restoration. Finally, we tested the network performance on multiple public datasets, and the results showed that our network outperformed other rain removal algorithms in terms of PSNR and SSIM metrics across multiple datasets, with an average metric improvement of O.S3dB compared to the current excellent algorithm MSPFN. This proves that the proposed rain removal network can effectively remove rain streaks and restore images while preserving detailed information.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Effective Reflector Area Expansion on the Thermal Deformation of Umbrella Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Umbrella antennas are widely utilized in high-orbit satellite communications due to their numerous advantages, including high precision, large aperture, and exceptional reliability. The effective geometric area of an antenna significantly influences its gain. Therefore, to enhance antenna performance, one can extend the boundaries of an umbrella antenna from the traditional catenary boundary to a circular one. Furthermore, the thermal stability of antennas in orbit is a pivotal factor impacting their performance. In this study, finite element models were established for both the conventional umbrella antenna and the one with an expanded effective geometric area. Using the finite element analysis (FEA) method, thermal deformations under various conditions were calculated for both models. The aim was to analyze the influence of extending the effective geometric area on the thermal stability of umbrella antennas.

articleTitle: A Path Planning Method for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Based on Improved Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of UAV applications, UAV flight path planning is a current hot research topic. In this regard, this paper establishes a path planning model for UAV in obstacle environments. On this basis, an improved artificial bee colony algorithm (MABC) is proposed for solving the respective model. The algorithm utilizes a reverse learning approach to optimize the quality of initial solutions. Additionally, it improves the search strategy of employed bees by introducing Levy and Cauchy distributions, thereby enhancing the global optimization capability of the traditional ABC algorithm. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is being validated through simulation experiments. Compared to the traditional ABC algorithm, the MABC algorithm reduces the flight distance by approximately 4.6% while meeting the requirements of UAV missions, thereby improving the UAV's flight efficiency and task effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Prompt-tuning Method For Low-Resource Relation Extraction Based On Enhanced-Prototype
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Prompt-tuning has been successful in low resource relation extraction. Since there are many relation labels in relation extraction task, it is a challenge to build label verbalizer, which mapping answer word to label space. To address this problem, we propose a prototype construction strategy based on relation semantic enhancement and Prototypical Network, which use attention mechanisms to calculate weighted averages of answer word embedding in support set. We also propose an entity type-enhanced answer word optimization approach to refine the answer word embedding based entity type information in relation context. We conduct experiments on the TACRED and TACRED-Revisit datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that our methods in enhance the accuracy of prototype construction and answer word embeddings.

articleTitle: FDM 3D printing quality detection system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of 3D printing technology, fused deposition modeling is the most widely used additive manufacturing process. Due to its forming principle and device structure, humps, cracks, holes and other defects are generated due to large accuracy errors in the printing process, which not only affects the appearance and performance of parts, but also causes waste of time and materials. In this paper, a method for detecting side surface defects of FDM 3D printing products is proposed, which integrates machine vision, image recognition and other related technologies. Aiming at the problem that cracks and holes that may be encountered in the printing process may cause the instability of the performance of the workpiece, the identification, judgment and early warning are carried out. The follow-up printing work of the defective workpiece is suspended to avoid the waste of time, greatly liberate manpower and improve the yield of 3D printing.

articleTitle: Research on Primary Side Control of Magnetic Coupled Radio Energy Transmission Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the load power of the traditional magnetic coupling resonant radio energy transmission system changes too much after the transmission distance changes, and combined with the application scenario of implantable medical equipment, a closed-loop control program of magnetic coupling radio energy transmission system based on DSP is designed. In this paper, a series model is selected for research and analysis, and sufficient and necessary conditions for load power stability are analyzed from the perspective of equivalent circuit. According to the characteristics of implantable medical devices that are difficult to control the secondary side, a set of control program based on primary side feedback is designed, and PID regulation is introduced, and finally how to achieve fast iteration of the control program at 1MHZ is studied.

articleTitle: Centerline Extraction of Line Structured Light in 3D Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: At present, 3D reconstruction of binocular vision is a hot topic in the field of computer vision, and the extraction of laser fringe centers in line structured light images is a crucial step. In order to obtain the feature point set between the images, it is necessary to extract the centerline of the linear structured light bands. Firstly, through image preprocessing, perform image stereo correction and image Gaussian filtering, and adaptive threshold segmentation algorithm is used to segment the stripe area of the line structured light, and the image thinning algorithm is used to extract the initial centerline of the line structured light. Finally, the point set is constructed and the initial centerline is optimized twice by the gray-scale centroid method, and the centerline of the linear structured light stripe is accurately extracted. The results show that, compared with the Steger algorithm and the skeleton thinning method, the proposed method extracts the centerlines of the linear structured light stripes with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Mechanical Structure Design of 2.4m Transonic Wind Tunnel Intelligent Assistant Assembly Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: For the special application of the 2.4m transonic wind tunnel models’ transportation and assembly, the mechanical structure of the 2.4m transonic wind tunnel intelligent auxiliary assembly robot is designed and implemented in this paper. Through the test, the robot meets all the performance indicators required for the transportation and assembly of the wind tunnel models, and can successfully complete the transportation and assembly of model within 300kg.

articleTitle: Development of Jet Plasma Three-electrode Switch and Its Trigger Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to conduct a more in-depth study on the reliable triggering problem of gas spark switches, Tie Weihao et al. proposed jet plasma triggering technology. This gas spark switch is based on the traditional three-electrode field distortion gas switch structure, and a plasma injection cavity consisting of an upper plate, an insulating ring and a pin electrode is embedded inside the trigger electrode.
