By applying a trigger pulse, a spark discharge is caused inside the jet chamber, which generates a large number of charged particles, which in turn turns on the switch. However, so far, the conduction characteristics of jet plasma have not been comprehensively studied. In view of this, this paper designs the structure of jet plasma-triggered gas switch, studies the plasma jet-triggered conduction characteristics under the trigger pulse amplitude, and further studies the relevant characteristics of the jet plasma-triggered gas gap switch to grasp the working state of the gas spark switch under the action of jet plasma.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Target Detection Algorithm Based on Binocular Camera and LiDAR Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Environment awareness technology is one of the key technologies of driverless cars, and the use of vision sensors or lidar alone has limitations in object detection. Based on the depth map generated by binocular camera, a vehicle target detection algorithm based on the fusion of binocular camera and liDAR is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the binocular image is generated by the adaptive stereoscopic matching network, and then the parallax map is converted into pseudo-point cloud, and the pseudo-point cloud is fused with the real Lidar point cloud. Then the Pillar rasterized target detection network is used to detect the true and false fusion point cloud, and the final vehicle target detection result is obtained. The proposed algorithm is verified on KITTI data set, and the experimental results show that the proposed method has significantly improved the accuracy of vehicle target detection compared with the advanced algorithms.

articleTitle: A Vibration-Based Method for Fault Diagnosis of Mechanical Loosening in High Voltage Reactors
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To address the issue of mechanical fault diagnosis of high-voltage shunt reactors, a method based on optimal vibration test location selection and convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed for loosening fault diagnosis of shunt reactors. Firstly, we combine the least squares method with R square to explore the sensitivity of vibration signals at different positions on the surface of shunt reactor boxes, thereby determining the optimal test points for vibration. Then, the one-dimensional vibration signals collected from the selected optimal test points are transformed into two-dimensional recurrent image information, and the normal and abnormal operating conditions are input into the CNN model for feature adaptive extraction and training, followed by classification processing to achieve high-precision detection and diagnosis of loosening faults in high-voltage shunt reactors. Finally, a vibration test platform is built using a 35kV high-voltage shunt reactor as the research object, and four different mechanical states are tested on the surface of the oil tank to verify the diagnostic performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Three-Phase Short-Circuit Electrodynamic Variation Characteristics of Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: When the transformer suffers from a short-circuit fault, the sudden short-circuit current will produce a huge short-circuit electric force, which may deform the windings and damage the insulation, especially the most serious three-phase symmetric short circuit of the double-winding transformer. It is of great value to study the electrodynamic variation characteristics of transformer winding short-circuit process, and then evaluate the short-circuit resistance of transformer winding. In this paper, ANSYS Maxwell finite element simulation software is used to establish a field-path coupling model. Through the external circuit, the three-phase short-circuit fault of the low-voltage winding is set at a certain time, and the electrodynamic variation characteristics under the impact short-circuit current are simulated and studied. The simulation results show that the influence of radial force on the winding is greater than that of axial force, especially on the intermediate phase B phase has the greatest influence.

articleTitle: Attention-Ordering LSTM for Financial Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Accurate forecasting in the financial field has been widely discussed. With the development of deep neural networks, it is also used in financial forecasting. In order to accurately predict financial time series, this paper proposes an attention-ordering long short-term memory model (AO-LSTM) combined with the empirical mode decomposition. As a popular deep recurrent network, long short-term memory can efficiently predict the financial time series. The preprocessing using empirical mode decomposition can improve the prediction accuracy. Experimental results show that the proposed prediction model obtains the best prediction performance.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Zero Value Characteristics of 110 kV Cathead Straight-Line Tower Suspension Double-String Insulators
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Porcelain insulators are widely used in high-voltage transmission lines. Over prolonged periods of operation, their insulation and mechanical performance inevitably deteriorate, which can lead to flashovers in the external insulation of transmission lines and even the explosion of porcelain insulators, causing power outages. In this study, a simulation was conducted using relevant finite element analysis software on a model of the 110 kV straight-line cathead tower suspension double-string insulators. The simulation considered the comprehensive effects of the tower structure, tower head shape, fittings, and conductors. Changes in the position and quantity of zero-value insulators were made to measure variations in the surrounding electric field strength and compared with the field strength distribution under normal operating conditions. The results indicate that the quantity and location of deteriorated insulators have a significant impact on the distribution of the surrounding electric field strength. When insulators near the high-voltage end reach zero value, there is a noticeable increase in the overall electric field strength of the insulator string. Deterior ation of insulators on the opposite side has limited impact on the field strength measured on this side. The research findings provide a theoretical basis for the diagnosis and detection of deteriorated insulators, offering valuable insights for the operation and optimization of insulators.

articleTitle: Research on a Test Method of Closing Delay of Elevator Brake under Emergency Braking Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In the elevator emergency braking condition, the elevator brake closing delay is too long, which will lead to the elevator sliding ladder, stopping distance is too large, and even the top or squatting bottom danger. The method for determining the action response time of elevator brake specified in GB/T 24478-2009 “Elevator Traction Machine” is applicable to the exit inspection and type test of brake components, but is not applicable to the elevator in use. This paper analyzes the mechanical structure and electrical control principle of the brake, divides the closing delay of the brake into electrical delay and mechanical delay according to the causes of delay, and puts forward a test method of brake delay of elevator brake based on emergency braking conditions. The test results of this method are helpful to further analyze whether the fault of the braking system is electrical fault or mechanical fault.

articleTitle: LFM Pulse Compared with Constant Frequency Pulse as the Excitation Signal in the Detection of Ultrasonic Distance in Water
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The linear frequency modulated pulse is used as the excitation source of ultrasonic non-destructive testing of sonar scanning equipment. Compared with the traditional constant frequency pulse excitation source, the detection echo of LFM pulse has more accurate detection distance accuracy and good anti-noise performance. In the experimental test, it is confirmed that the average relative error of the detection range accuracy of LFM is greatly reduced compared with the constant frequency pulse excitation source of three frequency bands under the LFM pulse bandwidth. The distance detection was carried out in different turbid water environments, which verified the robustness of the LFM pulse as an excitation source for ultrasonic detection, with good noise resistance and detection distance accuracy. The detection accuracy and efficiency of LFM pulse as excitation source have certain applicability in pipeline sonar detection, pool sonar detection, seabed sonar detection and other applications.

articleTitle: Motion Control of Mobile Robots Based on Improved Model Predictive Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The widespread application of mobile robots has driven continuous and in-depth research into their motion control to achieve higher stability and navigation accuracy. In this study, an innovative control method is proposed by integrating the Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization, algorithm into the Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework. A comprehensive comparative analysis is conducted between this approach and the conventional Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) method. Simulation results demonstrate that the improved PSO (IPSO)-based MPC method significantly outperforms the conventional PSO optimization in terms of tracking performance, stability, and navigation accuracy. The proposed approach exhibits greater adaptability and robustness in realtime motion control of mobile robots. Improved particle swarm optimization MPC showcases enhanced adaptability to changes and the ability to maintain a stable motion trajectory.

articleTitle: Radar Task Scheduling Based on Stochastic Fractal Search
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Task scheduling for radar resource management is an NP-hard problem due to the complexity of task parameter optimization. Approximate optimal solutions can be obtained by classical heuristic algorithms, but take a relatively long time. In this paper, a radar task scheduling method based on Stochastic Fractal Search (SFS) algorithm is proposed. The problem model is presented under the Quality of Service based resource allocation and management (Q-RAM) framework in order to ensure the overall mission effectiveness. We modified the SFS algorithm to fit the Q-RAM framework with a transformation strategy to unify the search space for different task parameters. The effectiveness of our method is verified by simulation experiments. Results show that, comparing to the other methods, our method can achieve approximately optimal scheduling performance while significantly reducing the calculation time.

articleTitle: Risk Balancing Routing Optimization Mechanism for Power Communication Business Based on Business Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the power communication network scale, the future power communication network will continue to evolve towards the development direction of smart grids. At the same time, more and more businesses are being carried on the power communication network, and the information transmission and collaboration between networks have become increasingly cumbersome, leading to a series of problems such as increased risk and path congestion. Considering the randomness and frequency of faults themselves, and the common shortest path selection mechanism can lead to a large number of services being allocated to certain links, resulting in uneven risk distribution. Therefore, in order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power grid, it is necessary to include risk balancing factors and conduct routing optimization research on power communication services. This will also have more practical significance and meet production, operation and maintenance needs.

articleTitle: Impedance Modeling of Grid Connected Converters Considering Frequency Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The wide application of wind and solar energy has connected large amount of power converters into the power system, which has changed the dynamic characteristics, and the power system dynamic stability has attracted much attention both in academia and industry. Currently, impedance analysis is widely used for power grid stability studies. So as to implement the impedance analysis, an accurate impedance model of the power converter is needed. In this paper, the impedance model of a commonly used LC converter is investigated. Considering the influence of phase locked loop (PLL) and frequency coupling on the impedance characteristics, a method combining harmonic linearization and symmetrical component analysis is utilized to derive the impedance model of the converter. The impedance obtained from a MATLAB/Simulink simulation model through frequency sweep verified the accuracy of the impedance analytic model.

articleTitle: Waveguide Microwave Switch based on 3D Printing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of heavy weight, long switching time and long production cycle of the spaceborne Rtype waveguide microwave switch in the X and below frequency bands, this article takes the R-type BJ84 waveguide microwave switch as an example and applies 3D printing technology to the RF cavity and RF rotor. Manufacturing can reduce the weight of microwave switches by 20%, shorten the production cycle by 70%, and reduce the switching time to less than 600ms. The reliability is significantly improved without losing the radio frequency performance of the switch. It provides a new way to manufacture waveguide microwave switches.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Discharge Characteristics in Inductively Coupled Plasma
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper investigated argon discharge process in inductively coupled plasma (ICP) source. We employed COMSOL software to create and simulate a two-dimensional plasma discharge model with a fluid-based model. We have acquired relevant parameter characteristic profiles through simulation plasma discharge at various discharge power and discharge pressure conditions. Within the pressure and power range studied, our research found that the maximum electron density is concentrated in the central region of the chamber. The electron density exhibits a gradual increment with the augmentation of power, while the electron temperature remains relatively stable with increasing power. The electron density gradually rises as pressure increases, while the electron temperature gradually diminishes with increasing pressure. Through computer simulation methods, the purpose of studying the discharge characteristics of plasma at various discharge parameters. Thus, the design of the discharge system can be improved to achieve the goal of optimizing the ICP source device.

articleTitle: SEU/SET Evaluation of Digital VLSI Design from Register Transfer Level to Layout Level
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As the feature size of integrated circuit (IC) continues to shrink, the soft failure probability induced by single event upset and single event transient (SEU/SET) for ICs exposing to space radiation is increasing. Since the soft failure probability is proportional to IC area, it is of great importance to study how to evaluate the sensitivity of very large scale integrated (VLSI) circuit to SEU/SET. In this paper, a generic fault injection simulation platform is designed to evaluate the responses of VLSI circuit to SEU/SET. Experiments show that the designed fault injection platform can cover the SEU/SET evaluation of VLSI design for the whole digital VLSI design flow, which includes original register transfer level design, logic gate-level netlist generated after synthesis and physical gate-level netlist generated after placement and routing. Furthermore, the proposed platform is able to extract the location information of utilized stand cells from the existing digital VLSI design flow, and carry out the simulation of single multiple bit upset and single event multiple transient (SMBU/SEMT) more accurately.

articleTitle: Energy-Saving Coal Mine Drainage System Based on PLC and WinCC Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Intelligent coal mine drainage system has become one of the main research directions of coal mine drainage, in order to save energy and reduce costs, this design utilizes PLC-WinCC technology to carry out a comprehensive design of intelligent drainage system in coal mine, and adopts the energy-saving mode of “avoiding the peaks and valleys” to realize energy saving and emission reduction of the drainage system. Siemens S7-1200 PLC is used as the controller to control the opening and closing of the pump valves and the starting and stopping of the motors; WinCC is used as the upper computer system to realize remote monitoring, data collection and control.

articleTitle: Modelling and Control of The Hybrid Storage System Providing Fast Frequency Support
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of hybrid energy storage technology, the hybrid energy storage system composed of battery and supercapacitor has become an important means to provide fast frequency support to the power systems. In order to study the ability of hybrid energy storage system to provide fast frequency support to the power grid. This paper firstly describes the working mechanism of the hybrid energy storage system, and establishes a detailed model of the charging and discharging process of the hybrid energy storage system. Based on the detailed model, different droop control strategies of hybrid energy storage system are compared, and a simplified model is proposed. The accuracy of the simplified model is verified by comparing with the detailed model.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prognosis of Power Semiconductor Devices Based on On-state Resistance Time Series Data and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Power semiconductor devices are the essential core components of modern power electronic equipment. Predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) of power semiconductor devices can help formulate reasonable maintenance strategies for power electronic equipment, thereby improving the availability of energy conversion systems. This article proposes a deep learning method for predicting the RUL of power semiconductor devices, which uses on-state resistance as a critical state parameter. A long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network (NN) model and a convolutional neural network (CNN) model are used to predict the on-state resistance time series data trend. NN models can predict a short section of future data with past data input. The RUL of power semiconductor devices is estimated through curve fitting based on past and predictive data. The proposed method is validated using the power MOSFET accelerated aging dataset from NASA, and the validation results show that the performance of the proposed method is superior to that of existing methods, such as extended Kalman filtering (EKF) and particle filtering (PF).

articleTitle: Automatically Generating Front-End Source Code Method for Complex Table Structures Based on Vue
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In enterprise software development, component-based front-end page technology is becoming increasingly important. However, traditional manual component-based programming is difficult to adapt to increasingly complex enterprise data table structures. This can lead to a large workload and slow down the development process. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method for automatically generating front-end source code for complex table structures based on Vue (AGT-Complex). This method uses hierarchical data structure recognition and expression to identify complex Excel table structures. It then forms a semantic mapping between business data tables and front-end program tables. Finally, it can generate code based on Vue components. Experimental results show that this method is effective and can greatly improve development efficiency. It can be used to develop complex data software with a high degree of automation.

articleTitle: Robot Path Planning Based on Improved Pelican Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To address more complex robot path planning problem, an improved Pelican optimization algorithm was proposed. Aiming at the problem of the weak local search ability of the Pelican optimization algorithm, firstly, a chaotic initialization strategy was introduced to improve the diversity of the initial population. Secondly, the golden sine algorithm was introduced to improve the local search ability of the algorithm. Finally, in order to prevent the algorithm from falling into the local optimum, the optimal individual chaotic search strategy was introduced to help the algorithm jump out of the local optimum. Four scale raster maps of 20x20, 30x30, 40x40 and 50x50 is used to test the proposed algorithm and comparison algorithms. In the path planning test, the path lengths found by the proposed algorithm are 40, and 102, respectively, which are shorter than those of the comparison algorithms, indicating that the proposed algorithm has good search performance for the robot path planning problem.

articleTitle: Research on Analog Circuit Fault Diagnosis Based on Optimized Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Although many methods have been proposed for fault diagnosis of analog circuits, due to the diversity of fault phenomena, large discreteness of component parameters, and widespread nonlinearity, analog circuit fault diagnosis is not fully mature in both theory and method. Therefore, based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and BP neural network combined with wavelet packet fault feature extraction, this study proposes a new method for analog circuit fault diagnosis that improves PSO optimized BP neural network and wavelet packet fault feature extraction. Improving the PSO algorithm by changing the method of obtaining inertia weights in the original PSO algorithm and adopting asynchronous change strategy factors. Ultimately, the training speed and accuracy of the neural network have been effectively improved. The simulation results show that the proposed method reduces the number of iterations while improving accuracy, and improves convergence speed. This provides a more efficient method for fault diagnosis of analog circuits.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Line Segment Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Traditional line segment detection algorithms, such as Hough transformation, LSD, etc., can achieve fast line segment detection, but still do not perform well in terms of accuracy and generalization. Methods based on deep learning can significantly improve accuracy and generalization capabilities, but the number of network parameters in most models is too large, resulting in increased computing cost and slow detection speed. We proposed a lightweight and efficient model with the existing efficient object detection model MobileNetv3 and pixel differentials for edge detection. Through a large number of experiments, we have achieved a good balance between the number of network parameters and the accuracy. Our network parameters are only 1M, and the detection performance is significantly better than other most advanced line segment detection methods under the same number of parameters.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Temperature and Humidity Monitoring Node and High Energy Efficiency Power Supply System in Seedling Room
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous progress and development of science and technology, the intelligent monitoring ability and automatic management level of the seedling room have been significantly improved. However, the number of domestic growing house control devices in our country is small and the reliability is low. Therefore, the development of intelligent greenhouse control devices suitable for our country's situation is of great significance to agricultural production, crop output enhancement and crop quality enhancement. This paper discusses the design of the precise temperature and humidity monitoring system of the seedling room, and reduces the energy consumption of the system by designing a multi-output power supply with low energy consumption.

articleTitle: Research on Workpiece Positioning Based on Stereo Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the proposal of Made in China 2025, the integration of industrial robots and machine vision technology on automated manufacturing production lines will further improve the degree of industrial automation. Conventional monocular vision guidance robot can only deal with two-dimensional problems, but can not solve the three-dimensional problem of workpiece positioning under complex conditions. Therefore, a workpiece recognition system based on binocular vision is proposed. Binocular stereo vision system is a kind of technology that imitates the principle of human binocular vision. The images obtained by two cameras are matched in stereo, so as to realize the perception and recognition of three-dimensional scenes. Stereo matching refers to finding the corresponding points between two images obtained by binocular vision system, so as to calculate the position and shape of the object in three-dimensional space. Its accuracy and efficiency directly affect the performance of the system. This paper aims to study the stereo matching problem in binocular stereo vision system, and improve the accuracy and robustness of stereo matching by analyzing and improving the stereo matching algorithm.

articleTitle: Poisson's Ratio Adjustment of Deployable Antenna Reflector Material
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As warp-knitted metal mesh of a deployable antenna reflector has negligible bending stiffness, when attached to curved boundaries under tension, a phenomenon called pillowing effect will deteriorate the surface accuracy of the reflector. This phenomenon can be derived from the momentless theory of thin shells. From the perspective of reflector materials, efforts to alleviate the pillowing effect has led to the emergence of Springback Reflector and Shell Membrane Antenna (Reflector). Both approaches have larger bending stiffness than metal mesh - no doubt this is favorable, the coming along large tensile modulus, however, make it impossible to tune the surface accuracy by tensioning the shell, as is popular adopted in mesh reflectors. The Springback Reflector and Shell Membrane Antenna must be cured on molds, this further strictly limited the physical size of the reflector. The concept of WEak STiffness COmposite Membrane (WESTCOM) aims to reduce the in plane tensile modulus, meanwhile sustaining sufficient bending stiffness to eliminate the pillowing effect. Bending stiffness is adjusted by tuning the thickness of the membrane, but this inherently increases the surface density of it. From the bending stiffness equation of thin plate, it becomes apparent when Poisson's ratio is approaching -1 the bending stiffness increases, while the in-plane modulus and the thickness of the plate remains small in quantity. Negative Poisson's ratio material is a rapidly developing metamaterial in recent years. If a reflector is made of membrane with negative Poisson's ratio, it may probably be another means to reduce pillowing effect. The deformed surface profile of a simply supported circular thin plate with negative Poisson's ratio, subjects to concentrated force acting at the center of the thin plate longitudinally is studied. Bending stiffness of the thin plate is tuned by varying the Poisson's ratio, the deformed surface profile is obtained by FEMA. The property of the deformed surface is evaluated by its Gaussian curvature. The final finding is a Poisson's ratio value that keeps the Gaussian curvature positive at every point on the deformed surface. An antenna reflector built by such kind of thin plate will be totally free of pillowing effect, and its surface profile be able to be optimized by applying discrete adjusting forces to it.

articleTitle: A utility model relates to a full-space self-walking pin filling robot of a transmission line
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the increasing scale of China's transmission lines and their increasingly heavy maintenance tasks, the new pin robot can automatically identify the faulty pins in the transmission lines and automatically repair them. The special operating environment of the transmission line requires the pin robot to accurately locate the fault in a small space, and send the installer at the end of the robotic arm to the designated position, which is a great test for the volume, flexibility and accuracy of the robot. In this paper, a pin robot design scheme consisting of a coupling plate, a mobile platform, a remote control platform, an image recognition algorithm, and an automatic defect elimination manipulator arm with rotation and variable structure in the whole space is proposed. The robotic arm design of this scheme is composed of two rotating joints and three pitching joints, and the robotic arm can be folded and contracted together in the nonworking state, reducing the occupied space, which is convenient for the lifting operation of the transmission line, and can be operated in three-dimensional space without dead angle through joint rotation and large and small arm swing when entering the working state. The robotic arm is connected to the mobile platform by means of a coupling plate, which can patrol the transmission line and automatically identify and clear faults.

articleTitle: Knowledge Aggregation of Importance Sampling Based on GNN for Music Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the development of mobile network and streaming media.it is difficult for people to find what they are really interested in from the massive music information. The recommendation system can solve this problem well. The traditional recommendation method ignores the rich information of graph structure, and GNN has advantages in graph representation learning. Therefore, this paper proposes a music recommendation model KAISG, which captures user preferences through the knowledge aggregation of important sampling based on GNN. Firstly, the item knowledge graph is constructed into a topological structure, and the correlation between items is effectively captured by mining their related attributes on KG. Then, the GNN is used to enrich the item representation and spread higher-order information by aggregating neighborhood information layer by layer. Especially, in order to aggregate the neighborhood information related to the current node more accurately, the model uses sampling based on importance to aggregate the neighborhood information of each layer when sampling the neighbors of each entity in KG, thus avoiding the introduction of noise in high-order relationships. In addition, GNN aggregates the representation and neighborhood information of a given entity, which can simulate high-order neighborhood information and capture the potential interests of users. Experiments on a real data set shows that our model is superior to the current baselines.

articleTitle: Online Violent Behavior Recognition Based on Lightweight Temporal Shift Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As a challenging task in the intelligent security monitoring system, violent behavior recognition plays a vital role in ensuring public safety. However, due to the complex semantic information about violent behaviors, there is still a lack of fast and reliable detection methods. To improve the accuracy and inference speed of violent behavior recognition, a lightweight convolutional neural network recognition algorithm named M-TSM based on the combination of temporal shift and spatial attention is proposed to solve the problems of insufficient motion information and slow inference speed in surveillance video images. First, random and equally spaced frames are drawn from the surveillance video to obtain the sequence of original video frames and normalized, then the depthwise separable convolution residual module is used to extract image features; the time shift module is used to fuse multiple frames of images to obtain video features containing multi-level time series information; finally, the spatial attention module focuses on the local features of the human body, so that the model can better distinguish between regular and violent videos, and output prediction results. The improved model is translated and compiled and then transplanted to the embedded device Jetson NX for deployment, which can realize edge computing, and the inference speed can meet the real-time requirements. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the improved M-TSM algorithm in the violent behavior dataset is 84.1%, which is 1.4% higher than the original TSM algorithm, and the inference time in edge computing equipment is reduced by 25%, it has better real-time detection performance.

articleTitle: Design of Tunnel Passive Deformation and Compression Support Based on SVM Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the adoption of machine learning methods has provided new insights for addressing the longstanding reliance on empirical design in tunnel and underground engineering. This study focuses on the problem of initial support structure damage caused by large deformations due to high ground stress weak surrounding rock in tunnels. Based on the concept of energy release, a novel passive deformation node is proposed. Through laboratory experiments on the node, its mechanical properties are analyzed. Subsequently, numerical simulations of the novel passive deformation node are conducted to validate its mechanical performance. Finally, the data reliability of the passive deformation node is verified using machine learning SVM (Support Vector Machine), and feedback is provided to the tunnel support system design for optimizing the support structure to improve design and construction schemes.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Driving Simulation System based on PreScan and Self-developed Driving Simulator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of new energy vehicle technology, autonomous driving technology has once again taken center stage. Before autonomous driving assistance modules can be implemented in real cars, they must undergo extensive testing. This research paper focuses on creating a static scene at the entrance of a high-speed ramp using PreScan, a self-developed driving simulator, to meet the testing requirements. The scene includes the test vehicle, other vehicles, and sensors such as TIS and Camera. The vehicle dynamics model is imported and set, and a TSR identification system and communication system with the driving simulator are established using Simulink. This enables the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing of the simulation model and the physical behavior of the driving simulator. The system can be utilized in various test scenarios and supports customized development.

articleTitle: Vehicle Trajectory Prediction based on LSTM and Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of the future trajectory of a vehicle under the influence of surrounding vehicles and the surrounding road environment, we propose a vehicle trajectory prediction model based on LSTM and graph convolutional network. Firstly, the historical vehicle trajectory features of the target vehicle and a certain range around it are extracted using a modified LSTM encoder. Additionally, we model inter-vehicle interactions through a self-attentive mechanism. Secondly, we construct a high-definition map by vectorizing the lane map and introduce the inflated convolution operator to aggregate topological relationships between lane nodes. We fuse the vehicle interaction information and lane node information using residual blocks that incorporate the graph attention mechanism, Generating predictions with Multi-modal predictor heads. Finally, We conducted experiments using the publicly available dataset Argoverse, and the results show that our predictive model outperforms other models in terms of comprehensive performance.

articleTitle: Interprovincial Shared Metering Point Energy Allocation Algorithm for Large-Scale AC/DC Hybrid Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: At the crucial stage of spot market construction in various regions of China's electricity market, the implementation of a unified settlement system for southern regional electricity markets requires an accurate and suitable algorithm for partitioning electric quantities in large-scale AC/DC hybrid power grids. In response to the limitations of traditional algorithms, this paper presents an iterative optimization algorithm for electric quantity partitioning based on practical production conditions. The proposed algorithm utilizes dispatch plans and actual measurement data to obtain practical results while minimizing alterations to traditional electric quantity partitioning outcomes. By providing a foundation for the design of a rational electricity cost calculation system, it effectively safeguards the interests of all market players. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated through simulations using settlement data from China Southern Power Grid.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Method of Stepper Motor for the Trajectory Correction Mechanism of the Diversion Trench
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Conventional ammunition has the characteristics of high speed and sensitive to changes in aerodynamic layout, so the control characteristics of two-dimensional trajectory correction mechanism driven by motor are required. Aiming at the problem of fast response and accurate control of the stepper motor in a new guided fluted trajectory correction mechanism, a fuzzy fractional-order PID controller was designed for the correction mechanism. A closed-loop vector control model was built in Simulink and the parameters of the fractional-order PID were adjusted by fuzzy rules. The response of stepper motor after starting under fuzzy fractional PID controller is analyzed. The simulation results show that the designed controller has obvious improvement effect on speed and position control, and has good characteristics such as faster response speed, higher precision and stronger load impact resistance, which improves the performance of the control system.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Fault Identification Method based on Attention Mechanism and Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In response to the problem of traditional algorithms being difficult to accurately detect unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) during line inspection due to complex scenes, a transmission line fault recognition method based on attention mechanism and deep neural network is proposed. The method is based on the design of a transmission line fault detection network that integrates attention models, called ATT-Net. Propose a model to introduce the Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) model, which achieves information exchange between channels through shared learning parameters to enhance the saliency of fault targets in complex backgrounds. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs better than traditional algorithms in terms of average detection accuracy, recall rate, and detection speed.

articleTitle: Continuous Identity Authentication Method Based on Channel State Information
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) technology is rapidly developing, and WiFi-based IoT devices utilize open wireless channels to transmit data, making them vulnerable to device spoofing attacks and communication data forgery. Achieving secure access for WiFi devices in resource-constrained environments and ensuring continuous identity authentication of accessing devices pose significant challenges. This paper proposes a method for continuous identity authentication of WiFi-based IoT devices based on Channel State Information (CSI), without altering the existing hardware structure of wireless IoT terminals. By extracting the channel state information from the wireless signals of the devices, a unique identity fingerprint is formed for each device. The channel state information of legitimate devices is collected to create a fingerprint database. The legitimate fingerprints are then input into a machine learning algorithm to train a classifier, which is used for continuous identity authentication of subsequent accessing devices. Experimental results demonstrate that the CSI-based fingerprint features can effectively and continuously identify WiFi-based IoT devices with high accuracy and good recognition performance.

articleTitle: Database Multi-Connection Query Optimization Based on Improved Snake Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In the face of a large amount of data and complex multi-connection query requirements, Finding a quick way to search for the best query execution plan is a research hotspot in improving database query speed. This paper proposes a database multi-connection query optimization method based on the improved snake optimization algorithm, An iterative chaotic mapping is utilized to initialize the population and enhance the population's diversity; A multi-armed bandit strategy is employed for the dynamic selection of population behavior modes; furthermore, an opposites-learning strategy is employed to update the optimal solution and population acquired at each iteration, thereby enhancing the algorithm's self-learning capability. Experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can find a better query execution plan in a shorter time.

articleTitle: Novel Energy Harvesting Method-Using Capacitance Inducing Voltage to Harvest Energy Under the Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In response to the issues of existing energy harvesting devices being susceptible to weather conditions, complex installation, short lifespan, and high insulation requirements, this invention proposes a high-voltage transmission line energy harvesting method based on capacitor plate energy collection. This method effectively overcomes the drawbacks of existing energy harvesting devices and offers advantages such as stable power supply, environmental friendliness, and ease of operation. It is particularly suitable for powering online monitoring devices. Based on the principles of energy collection using capacitor plates, this invention analyzes the characteristics of energy collection with capacitor plates and designs the corresponding equivalent circuit. On this basis, a three-dimensional finite element calculation model is established to calculate the distribution characteristics of the electric field around the high-voltage transmission line. Since the effectiveness of energy collection is determined by the induced voltage, the model of this invention calculates the magnitude of the induced voltage on the capacitor plates and discusses the influence of capacitor plate size and position on the induced voltage. Finally, the size of energy collection is determined based on the magnitude of the induced voltage, thereby finding the optimal configuration of the capacitor plates to provide energy for the monitoring devices of the high-voltage transmission line.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv5 Metal Surface Defect Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Surface defect detection is a key step in the process of product inspection. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional metal surface defect detection in efficiency and accuracy, this paper proposes an improved metal surface defect detection model based on YOLOv5. The improved YOLOv5 model realizes bidirectional cross-scale connection and fast normalized fusion by improving the feature fusion structure and adds a small object detection layer. The performance of the improved model is improved and the average accuracy is 95.3%, which is 2.0% higher than original YOLOv5 model, the number of missed detections is also reduced.

articleTitle: Commodity Review Recommendation Based on Neural Network and Multiple Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This study introduces the “Neural-Multi-Attentional Recommendation” (N-MAR) model, combining multiple attention mechanisms and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to enhance consumer preference identification in e-commerce networks. The N-MAR employs a multilevel attention model in e-commerce review networks to discern vital information from reviews, addressing the hierarchical structure of words and sentences that influence consumer preferences. By weighting reviews and utilizing a hybrid model of neural networks and matrix decomposition, it discerns hidden user-product relationships, personalizing recommendations through review content analysis. Evaluation on real e-commerce datasets reveals superior accuracy and efficiency compared to various popular algorithms, improving precision by up to 0.081 and recall by 0.083 on four Amazon datasets, with an average F1-SCORE enhancement of 0.037. Despite its high time complexity and omission of social relationship impacts on recommendations, N-MAR effectively captures consumer shopping preferences, offering more personalized recommendation services.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of 4-Bit Absolute-Value Detectors Design Strategies and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The investigation of 4-bit absolute-value detectors holds paramount significance owing to their versatile applicability across diverse domains, spanning signal processing, automation control, and healthcare. Through the enhancement of 4-bit absolute-value detectors, the potential to cater to the distinctive demands of various application realms becomes more pronounced, thereby imparting tangible benefits to both society and the engineering sector. This research is dedicated to the minimization of detector latency and power consumption while preserving the absolute-value detection function, consequently elevating the comprehensive performance of 4-bit absolute-value detectors. Firstly, an innovative circuit topology for the 4-bit Absolute-Value Detector was devised, wherein the process of obtaining the absolute value of the input signal (x[n]) was inverted through a conversion to 2‘s complement format. Moreover, the conventional comparator was supplanted by a chain adder with a reduced number of logic gates. Subsequently, a logic style optimization strategy was implemented, employing static CMOS logic for AND and OR gates, and PTL logic for XOR gates, with the aim of minimizing latency and energy consumption. Lastly, a variable-controlling approach was utilized in calculations, encompassing the evaluation of delay and energy reduction when considering Vdd only, Sizing only, or both Vdd and Sizing, followed by the selection of the most advantageous energy reduction through result comparison. In the course of the project's validation phase, the 4-bit absolute-value detector designed herein featured a total of 22 logic gates. Through meticulous circuit variable optimization based on Matlab mathematical model, the latency of the 4-bit absolute-value detector reached a remarkable low of 14.6 * FO4, accompanied by a substantial energy savings of up to 69.26%. The refinement of the circuit topology, the optimization of transistor-level logic gate implementation, and the adjustment of both Vdd voltage and transistor sizes collectively contributed to a significant enhancement in detector performance. This enhancement not only translated into reduced energy consumption but also yielded decreased latency. The efficacy of this design approach is transferable to other circuit designs, offering the potential for performance enhancements.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting with TDCI: Temporal Decomposition and Channel Independence
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Given the substantial load fluctuations, pronounced stochasticity, and non-linearity influenced by factors like weather and temperature in power load forecasting, we present a short-term load forecasting model based on TDCI. This model introduces several enhancements to boost forecasting accuracy. Firstly, TDCI employs temporal decomposition, separating time-series data into seasonal and trend components, enabling the capture of inherent seasonal patterns and long-term trends that significantly impact load forecasting accuracy. Additionally, the incorporation of locality-sensitive hashing attention efficiently processes relevant temporal patterns, enhancing model performance while reducing computational complexity. Lastly, a channel independence approach is applied to each variable, allowing tailored processing based on individual feature characteristics. This adaptive feature handling ensures effective capture of distinct properties, thereby enhancing forecasting accuracy. Experimental evaluations on a real-world power load dataset demonstrate the superior forecasting precision of our proposed model compared to existing models.

articleTitle: A Multi-source Fault Diagnosis Method for Single-stage Gearbox Based on Information Integration of Vibration and Abrasive Particles
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy in fault diagnosis for gearboxes, a diagnostic method integrating vibration and abrasive information is adopted to separate and identify combined faults in gears. A BP neural network is used to construct a basic model for fault diagnosis of gears and determine the inputs and outputs of the model. Through the comparison of the accuracy of fault recognition based on single sensor information and that based on information integration, the feasibility of information integration is verified in fault recognition. A particle swarm optimization algorithm is employed to optimize the BP neural network, demonstrating that the particle swarm optimization algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of the BP neural network in fault recognition of the gearbox. A TFSWT algorithm is used to select and weight feature parameters, so as to verify the superiority of TFSWT -PSO-BP network model and endow a certain theoretical significance for studying the fault diagnosis of gears.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition Based on Fusion of Different Channel and Spatial Information Features
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: At present, the leading method of planar and nested named entity recognition is to predict by word-word relationship, but there will be noise interference in multi-granularity dilated convolution. In the relationship prediction part, multiple Dropouts will discard important information and lead to model instability. In this paper, the improved convolutional block attention module (CBAM) is used to consider the relationship between different channels and spatial regions, and L2 regularization loss is added to the joint prediction layer to prevent overfitting without losing important features, which improves the overall model performance. Experiments show that the F1 score of this method is 0.28 %, 0.71 % and 0.92 % higher than that of the leading method on CoNLL2003, GENIA and Resume datasets, respectively, which proves its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-Voltage Distribution Line Load Pre-Balanced System Based on Commutation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Extensive research and development efforts have been dedicated to the investigation and advancement of the load commutation method-based automatic commutation device (CD) as a means to mitigate three-phase imbalance in low-voltage distribution networks (LVDNs). However, the present automatic commutation approach employs real-time balancing techniques. This entails that when the device detects an imbalance surpassing the threshold, it promptly executes commutation operations on certain power consumers where the user experiences a significant level of current, which poses challenges in the process of commutation. In this paper, a commutation-based load-pre-balanced system for low-voltage distribution line is created and put into practice. The system has the capability to perform the commutation operation prior to the user's utilization of electricity, hence eliminating the necessity for conducting high current commutation, which can mitigate the potential risks associated with automatic CD commutation. Firstly, a novel pre-balanced phase change strategy is introduced, accompanied by the construction of a pre-balanced system. Two commutation strategies, namely current-based and voltage-based, are designed for the pre-balanced system. Additionally, the effectiveness of the pre-balanced system in controlling the three-phase line load imbalance is verified by simulation on the MATLAB/Simulink platform. Finally, the hardware component of the system is realized through the use of the PIC18F27QI0 micro controller as the central controller. On the other hand, the system software component is developed by employing the programming languages C and Python, also a prototype is made for real environment testing. The experimental findings indicate that the designed pre-balanced system has the capability to efficiently regulate the imbalance in the three-phase line load.

articleTitle: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Radio Frequency System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The nuclear magnetic resonance radio frequency (RF) system comprises RF transmitting system, RF coil and RF signal receiving system. Together, these components form the backbone of the nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) RF system, enabling accurate imaging and spectroscopy. It emphasizes the importance of RF technology in nuclear magnetic resonance imaging and spectroscopy, which is revolutionary for medical diagnosis, material analysis and scientific exploration. The principle of nuclear magnetic resonance involves the interaction of atomic nuclei with magnetic fields and radio frequency pulses to explore molecules' structure, composition and dynamic processes. This paper discusses the development of NMR RF systems, with emphasis on the design of RF coils, signal modulation strategies, and their interaction with NMR phenomena. Subsequent sections will delve into the complexity of the components of NMR RF systems, explaining RF emissions, RF coils, and RF signal receiving systems. The RF transmitting system generates RF pulses, the RF coil sends and receives signals, and the RF receiving system receives and processes NMR signals.

articleTitle: User Identification based on Behavior Feature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The issue of identity management and information security in cyberspace is becoming increasingly important, and the issue of how to effectively identify through user behavior urgently needs to be addressed. At present, biometric recognition technologies have certain limitations. This article combines deep learning methods and uses the BERT model to extract input text information features to generate word vectors. It uses a bidirectional GRU network with local and global attention mechanisms for training, and finally uses a softmax classifier to classify the user identity recognition model. The model in this article has significantly improved its performance in user identity recognition tasks based on behavioral features.
