articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Smart Solid-State Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The emergence of renewable energy makes the traditional power system face great challenges, and the construction of energy Internet is the way to solve the problem. As the core component of the energy Internet, smart solid-state transformer (ST) is susceptible to power fluctuations from various load ports, which may cause imbalance of its own power supply and demand at all levels and lead to voltage instability. Therefore, it is crucial to determine the stability boundaries for stable operation. This paper proposes a method of stability determination based on power balance point. Based on the average model of a three-level ST and the Jacobian matrix is derived. The singularity of the Jacobian matrix is used to determine the stability of the ST. The study of the power balance point shows that the instability of the ST upper stage causes the output voltage to drop, resulting in the instability of the lower stage, while the instability of the lower stage does not necessarily lead to the instability of the upper stage. A three-stage type ST simulation model based on MATLAB/SIMULINK is developed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method .

articleTitle: Identification of defects in overhead ground lines based on GA-BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The harsh operating environment of overhead ground lines inevitably produces structural damage. Accurate measurement of the size of defects on the surface of the overhead ground line can effectively determine the safety of the structural condition of the overhead ground line. However, it is difficult to quantitatively recognize the size of defects on the surface of the overhead ground line by the current structural condition detection methods, or the detection accuracy and efficiency can hardly meet the actual requirements. In this paper, we firstly constructed a finite element model for magnetic leakage detection of overhead ground line, analyzed the change rule of defect size and magnetic leakage field in the space around the defects and determined the magnetic leakage characteristic quantity, and then used the finite element calculation to construct the magnetic leakage sample database of different sizes of defects, and then utilized matlab to construct the GA-BP neural network to realize the accurate prediction of the width and depth of defects on the surface of the overhead ground line. This method can efficiently and reliably detect the defect size of overhead ground line to ensure the structural safety of overhead ground line, which is of great significance for the safe and stable operation of power system.

articleTitle: Identification of ID Card Number Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: BP neural network has been applied extensively in image processing, with ID card recognition systems being utilized in every facet of everyday life. To reduce the error rate and enhance the effectiveness of use, we employ BP neural network to refine the precision of identity recognition. To begin, the ID card image is pre-processed, then the number is pinpointed and divided, and the pertinent parameters are set to be trained through BP neural network. The output is produced once the precise value is matched, and subsequently the parameters are fine-tuned to attain a greater level of accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Visual Semantic Embedding with Adaptive Pooling and Instance-Level Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To enhance the effectiveness of image-text matching, this study introduces a novel approach known as Adaptive Visual Semantic Embedding with Adaptive Pooling and Instance-Level Interaction (AdIVSE). AdIVSE employs an adaptive pooling technique to autonomously determine the most suitable pooling strategy for aggregating visual and textual embeddings. Additionally, it incorporates an instance-level interaction module and a dynamic hard-negative loss function to facilitate the discrimination of subtle distinctions within similar image-text pairs, thereby improving fine-grained image-text matching. Qualitative and ablation experiments conducted on the Flickr30k dataset demonstrate that the proposed network exhibits the capability to discern similar instances. This capability translates into superior performance in fine-grained matching scenarios.

articleTitle: Deformation Behavior of Metal Plate by High-Frequency Induction Heating Under Buckling Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Buckling mechanism (BM) plays a dominant role when we need to form convex shape in the high-frequency induction heat forming. To explore deformation behavior of metal plate under BM, in this paper, a 3D finite element simulation has been carried out accounting for geometric and material nonlinearities. Effect of parameters on bending angle, including effective power of inductor, coil diameter, moving speed and thickness of plate, is studied. Using similar method as in laser forming, an inequality which can distinguish the bending direction is obtained, and the analytical results are good agreement with the numerical results. To predict bending angle of metal plate under BM, an analytical model has been derived based on similarity of temperature distribution. The analytical results are experimentally validated.

articleTitle: A Full Process Mechanized Transmission Line Engineering Duration Prediction Model Based on Bayesian-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a Bayesian LSTM neural network based transmission line engineering schedule estimation method to address the issue of schedule management in the construction process of transmission line engineering, by utilizing less engineering information to accurately and quickly predict and compare the project's current progress information, as well as assessing the rationality and effectiveness of the construction plan. Uncovering the elements that shape the engineering cost of transmission line, and taking these as the input variables and the entire construction period of the transmission line project as the output, is the aim of this analysis. A Bayesian LSTM prediction model with a double-layer structure is established, and the prediction model is trained and validated using actual engineering data. An example of the calculation demonstrates that the model is adept at accurately and rapidly forecasting the entire duration of transmission line engineering, making it suitable for the detection and control of progress and quality during the construction process.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a New Generation Intelligent Monitoring System for Subway Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In response to the low level of intelligence, harsh operating environment, and high failure rate of the existing subway power supply system (SPSS), this article proposes a new generation of subway power supply intelligent monitoring system design scheme. By real-time monitoring the operation of key components such as IGBT and aluminum electrolytic capacitors in the SPSS, and collecting relevant real-time operation data, the health status of the intelligent monitoring system is monitored; The system automatically studies and analyzes real-time data collected, calculates the remaining service life of relevant components of the SPSS based on relevant mathematical models, and promptly alerts the system of abnormal situations. According to the design scheme, a corresponding prototype has been developed. The operation of the prototype can correctly display the operation status and remaining service life of key components of the SPSS, and can real-time grasp the health status of the SPSS, thereby improving the maintenance and repair efficiency of the system, reducing maintenance and repair costs, ensuring the stability and reliability of the subway power supply, and achieving the expected goals.

articleTitle: Defect Detection Method for Substation Equipment Based on Lightweight Improved YOLOv5s Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Intelligent substation equipment defect detection task exists in the defect distribution, defects in the appearance of a variety of changes in the characteristics of the features, and feature extraction difficulties. This paper proposes a defect detection method for substation equipment based on the lightweight, improved YOLOv5s algorithm. The method takes YOLOv5s as the base detection model. It reconstructs the convolution operation process of the model to obtain data features based on the Ghost lightweight module, which improves the detection speed of the model. A loss function based on the KL scatter distribution is used as the target frame localization loss function to improve the model's accuracy for fuzzy image detection. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can improve the detection accuracy of the fuzzy fault target image while ensuring real-time detection, which meets the needs of intelligent substation equipment defect detection.

articleTitle: Prediction of Low-Temperature Energy Consumption and Driving Range of Pure Electric Vehicles Based on the CatBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This study utilizes real road driving data for a specific model of pure electric vehicles to segment and select kinematic segments. Feature parameters are extracted from these segments and subjected to dimensionality reduction analysis. Based on the reduced principal component feature parameters, a particle swarm optimization-based K-means clustering analysis is conducted to classify driving conditions by energy consumption rate. The results reveal that the average energy consumption rate is lowest during medium-speed driving conditions and highest during high-speed driving conditions, with a 7.85% and 12.62% increase, respectively, compared to low-speed conditions. A CatBoost algorithm prediction model is developed based on these principal component feature parameters to forecast lowtemperature energy consumption and driving range. The results indicate a maximum absolute error of 0.52 kWh and an average relative error of 3.46% for cumulative energy consumption prediction, with a final relative error of 0.59% upon trip completion. The maximum absolute error for predicted remaining range compared to real remaining range is 8.18 km, with an average absolute error of 1.77 km and an average relative error of 4.04%.

articleTitle: Design of High Pulse Repetition Frequency Glow Discharge Pseudospark Switch
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The pseudospark switch is a low-pressure switch that operates on the left branch of the Paschen curve. It has characteristics such as short breakdown time (<10ns), high pulse current (>100kA), and long operational lifespan, making it highly suitable for high-power pulse modulation. This article optimizes the structure of traditional pseudospark switches by incorporating features such as glow discharge dual-pulse triggering and the addition of a Faraday cup. Through testing, it has been found that the pulse repetition frequency (PRF)can reach 420Hz, the peak forward anode voltage can reach 46kV, the peak anode current can reach 51kA, the operating voltage is 35kV, and the average anode current is 2.1A.

articleTitle: An Active Distribution Network Net Load Current Composite Directional Protection Method Based on 5G
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the large number of access to DG, the structure of the distribution network has become more and more complex. It affects the performance of distribution network protection, makes the traditional current protection rectification match more difficult, and even difficult to meet the requirements of protection. An active distribution network net load current composite direction area protection method based on 5G is proposed to effectively solve the problem of active distribution network protection matching difficulty. Firstly, an active distribution network net load current composite direction protection architecture based on 5G is constructed. 5G technology and edge computing are utilised to improve the data transmission capability and processing capability. Secondly, a new method of active distribution network net load current composite direction protection is proposed. The powerful computing capability of the edge side is used for net load prediction, and the difference between the net load prediction current and the fault current is used as the protection start value, which reduces the influence of the intermittency and randomness of the distributed power supply on the protection setting value. Using the improved node matrix containing distributed power sources, distributed power source nodes and their upstream and downstream nodes are effectively identified. The fault direction information of multiple ends is used as the action logic judgement of the protection to quickly judge the fault line. Finally, the reliability and speed of the proposed method are verified by the improved IEEE33 node distribution network, which has certain application value for the protection of active distribution networks.

articleTitle: Improved High-Dynamic Attitude Measurement Cone Error Compensation Algorithm and Real-Time Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Projectile conical motion causes significant control disturbances in the guidance system. In order to compensate for this error, a new conical error compensation algorithm has been analyzed to improve the accuracy and real-time performance of the bullet attitude control system in a high-dynamic motion environment. Combining the quaternion method and the triad equivalent rotation vector method, an improved triad quaternion attitude algorithm based on modified Rodriguez parameters for angle increment output is utilized. Derive the corresponding differential equation expressions to establish the mathematical model for solving the attitude using the improved Triad quaternion algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that compared to traditional conical error compensation algorithms, improved algorithms can more effectively compensate for conical errors, with an average accuracy improvement of approximately 17.32<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>,reduce computational load in high-dynamic environment and improve real-time performance by approximately 22.54%.

articleTitle: A Random Forest Regression-Based Method for Predicting Energy Consumption of Turning Operations on CNC Machine Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of energy consumption prediction and consider the influence of tool wear on energy consumption prediction during turning, this paper proposes a turning energy consumption prediction method based on random forest regression algorithm. The pre-processed experimental data are input into the random forest regression algorithm for training and fitting, and the model is optimized by adjusting parameters with grid search and cross-validation, and finally compared with the prediction models constructed based on artificial neural networks, support vector machines and decision regression trees, the prediction accuracy of the proposed prediction method in this paper is improved by 38.4%, 27.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and 33.4 %, respectively, compared with other methods. Compared with the prediction model without considering tool wear, the accuracy was improved by about 11%. The results show that the prediction model of turning energy consumption constructed by the random forest regression algorithm proposed in this paper has high accuracy and practicality.

articleTitle: Dynamics Analysis of Compound Pendulum Jaw Crusher with Bearing Clearance
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Previous dynamic studies of the complex pendulum jaw crusher neglected the bearing clearance between the eccentric shaft and the moving jaw, which is crucial for analyzing the effect of bearing clearance on the dynamic performance of the crusher. By employing the Lagrange multiplier method, a dynamic model considering the bearing clearance of the complex pendulum jaw crusher was established, and the effects of different clearance values on the dynamic performance of the crusher were analyzed. The results indicate that reducing the clearance value can improve the dynamic performance of the complex pendulum jaw crusher, enhance its operational stability, and increase the bearing lifespan.

articleTitle: Virtual Synchronous Generator Control Strategy Based on Fixed-Time Terminal Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To enhance microgrid performance and improve system operational stability, a sliding-mode-based Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control strategy is introduced, capitalizing on the advantages of VSG and sliding mode control. The energy storage inverter employs a dual-layer control structure. The upper-layer VSG control provides inertia and damping, serving as a reference voltage source for the lower layer. And the lower-layer sliding mode control enhances system response speed and robustness by treating the system's load current as a disturbance, enabling the system to mitigate the inherent ‘chattering’ of sliding mode variable structures while maintaining stability. A terminal sliding mode is designed based on the deviation between output voltage and reference voltage, ensuring the convergence of the system's output voltage error within a fixed time to a neighborhood of the equilibrium point. Finally, the effectiveness of this control strategy is validated through MATLAB/Simulink simulations.

articleTitle: Independent Pitch Control of Wind Turbines Based on Improved Northern Goshawk Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Northern Goshawk Algorithm (NGO) is a newly proposed swarm intelligence optimization algorithm, which has high convergence accuracy and good stability, but still has certain limitations. For example, the problem of initial solution random distribution in the process of population initialization and the problem of falling into local optimization in the later stage of iteration. In this paper, Sin mapping, adaptive weight factor, adaptive t-distribution are used to improve NGO, and an improved algorithm-SWNGO is proposed. and SWNGO is proposed for parameter tuning of independent pitch controllers of wind turbines. Experimental results show that the algorithm is more competitive than other algorithms under the CEC2017 test function. In terms of the performance of the independent pitch controller, the controller after parameter tuning has better performance in reducing the pitch and yaw torque at the hub.

articleTitle: Multi-Target Trajectory Optimization of Dual-Arm Robot Based on NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low working efficiency, large energy consumption loss and strong joint wear during the operation of the robot, an algorithm based on NSGA-II is proposed to optimize the time, energy consumption and impact trajectory of the dual-arm robot mounted on the plate. In this study, the forward motion model of the robot is established, and the inverse solution is obtained by improving the particle swarm optimization algorithm, and the dual-arm tight coordination model is deduced. Secondly, NSGA-II algorithm is used to optimize the time-energy-impact multi-objective of cubic B-spline curve, and fuzzy evaluation method is used to screen the potential optimal solution in Pareto solution set. Finally, Adams software is used to simulate and verify the correctness and effectiveness of the algorithm. The results of this paper provide an effective research method for dual-arm trajectory planning.

articleTitle: An Environment-Adaptive Stereo Vision Inertial Odometer
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a stereo-vision inertial odometer that incorporates GPS signals, a technique that allows for environmental adaptation. The VIO system, which uses vision as the main observation information, becomes unreliable when the system faces low-texture, high-depth-of-field scenes, so our algorithm introduces GPS information as an absolute observation, uses the IMU for short-term derivation, then corrects its cumulative drift by using the visual relative information and the GPS absolute measurements, and realizes the environment through adaptive identification through covariance matrices and by correcting the corresponding weights adaptive. Compared with the traditional VIO, the introduction of GPS enables the system to improve the overall accuracy in both x-axis and y-axis directions without adding extra computation, which is 2.25% and 4.3% respectively, with an overall maximum drift error of 2.2%. The impact of GPS information is mainly reflected in the improvement of the diversity of the usage scenarios.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Power Measurement Based on MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Power, as one of the most important electrical parameters of a power system, obtaining accurate power values in simulation or modeling has an important impact on the system steady-state analysis. In the simulation environment of MATLAB/Simulink, by constructing different source load scenarios for single-phase and three-phase circuits, simulation experiments are carried out by utilizing the power measurement modules, focusing on the similarities and differences of the power measurement of each power module in different application scenarios, which will provide references to the simulation simulation and engineering practice, so as to come up with the optimal solution.

articleTitle: A Study on Counter Rotating Turbine/Counter Rotating Propfan Integrated Performance Simulation Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Based on the principles of aerodynamic and thermodynamic, this paper presents a novel method to implement integrated performance analysis for counter-rotating turbine (CRT) and counter-rotating propfan (CRP) of direct drive propfan engine. According to the structure and features of directed-driven propfan engine, a steady-state component-level model of directed-driven propfan engine is established which is capable to simulate performance behaviors. Referring to the data from Cranfield University, the results show the off-design point simulation is able to accurately simulate the performance behaviors in the flight envelope. Above work verifies the effectiveness of the engine modeling methodology. Moreover, this paper studies the integrated performance behaviors of counterrotating turbine and counter-rotating propfan to analyze the coupling relations of aerodynamic and mechanical, as well as the regulation of propfan incidence angle in variety of operating state. Above efforts enrich the theory of aeroengine simulation modeling and provide a reference for propfan engine control schedule design as well.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach for Recommendation Systems: Fusing Review Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Traditional approaches heavily rely on user ratings as the main source for generating recommendations. However, the inherent sparsity of ratings poses a significant challenge in delivering accurate and personalized recommendations. In this study, we propose an innovative and deep fusion personalized recommendation model that harnesses emotional features extracted from user reviews, with the goal of providing highly accurate and personalized recommendations. Our model incorporates cutting-edge techniques, including BERT and Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network, which are renowned for their contextual understanding capabilities. By leveraging these advanced techniques, we can capture the fine-grained sentiment information embedded within user reviews, enabling comprehensive understanding of the conveyed emotional aspects. Furthermore, we introduce an enhanced feature weight calculation method that synergistically integrates lexicon-based techniques and attention mechanisms. Through meticulous experimentation on a comprehensive and diverse dataset, we empirically demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed deep fusion model. The experimental results validate its superior performance compared to various baseline models, showcasing substantial improvements. By leveraging emotional features extracted from user reviews, our sophisticated model empowers e-commerce platforms to offer highly reliable and personalized recommendation services.

articleTitle: Gait Design of a Bipedal Walking Robot Based on the Center of Gravity
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This study aims to design the gait of a bipedal walking robot based on the center of gravity to achieve stable walking ability. By analyzing the human walking principle and robot structural parameters, the center of gravity model was established and simulated using MATLAB. In terms of gait planning, according to the actual structure of the robot and the characteristics of human walking, the walking attitude and center of gravity trajectory of the robot are planned, and the gait parameters are set. Particular attention was paid to the design of the robot's gait when ascending stairs, considering geometric constraints and joint steering. Through MATLAB simulation, the trajectory of the center of gravity in the process of ascending the stairs is analyzed, and the rationality and feasibility of the gait design are verified. Finally, by solving the kinematic equation and simulating, the effect and reliability of gait design are further verified. The results of this study are expected to improve the mobility and adaptability of bipedal walking robots in complex environments and provide a useful reference for future robot design and control.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Diagnosis Based on FFT-1DCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Intelligent fault diagnosis of rotating machinery has been an important topic in mechanical fault research. Due to the difficulty of manual diagnosis in providing timely and accurate results, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been widely used for fault diagnosis. However, some existing methods directly process time-domain signals using artificial neural networks, lacking analysis of frequency domain information, leading to limited accuracy. Others extract frequency domain information but result in complex networks with numerous parameters, requiring extensive training time and insufficient diagnosis speed. In this paper, we propose an intelligent diagnostic approach based on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (1DCNN). We validate the ef- fectiveness of this approach using the Case Western Reserve University's rolling bearing dataset, achieving diagnostic accu- racy of over 99% for different types and severities of damage datasets. Moreover, the proposed method achieves a diagnosis speed of 115ms, demonstrating higher accuracy and efficiency compared to existing diagnostic methods and enabling real-time fault diagnosis of bearings.

articleTitle: Common Faults of ZPW-2000A Frequency Shift Track Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: frequency shift track circuit is widely used in railway system operation and is very important for efficient, safe, and stable train operation. Common faults of ZPW-2000A frequency shift track circuit are studied, the fault phenomena and treatment process are given, and causes of several common faults are analysed.

articleTitle: Disaster Monitoring in Tibet Region Based on Multi-Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of population and international climate change, the risk of natural or environmental disasters are also gradually increasing, and the impact on the safe operation of China's power grid and power dispatching is also increasing. In big data environment, a large amount of relevant information generated by various news platforms or social media platforms when disasters occur can provide data support for disaster detection and information acquisition. Aiming at all kinds of news or Weibo posts data generated during disasters in Tibet, this paper builds a BiLSTM-CRF (Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory-Conditional Random Fields) model with multi-head attention mechanism (BMHAC) to detect disaster information. The experimental results show that the F1 value extracted by the model reaches 0.907, which can provide additional data support in addition to remote sensing or sensor data for disaster detection and information acquisition in Tibet.

articleTitle: Financial Early Warning Optimization Model Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In the process of financial management early warning, neural network models are affected by the convergence speed of the model, which can cause certain uncertainty or inaccuracy in the final warning. Therefore, this study uses chaotic particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize the neural network model and improve the reliability and accuracy of financial management early warning. To ensure the early warning effect of the neural network model, a chaotic optimization algorithm with ergodic characteristics is introduced into the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm. The purpose is to adjust the premature phenomenon of particles in the particle swarm algorithm and avoid the formation of a large number of particles near inert points. By combining the advantages of the two algorithms to the greatest extent, the ergodic properties of chaos can be assigned to each particle in this way, ensuring optimization efficiency while obtaining global optimal values. The test results indicate that the optimized model can obtain the best global traversal solution; Complete convergence with a fitness value of 0.000 5 when the number of iterations is 50; Good global optimization performance, able to complete financial management warnings with zero error, and has excellent warning reliability.

articleTitle: Multifactorial Differential Evolution Algorithm with Intermediate Population
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Multifactorial optimization algorithm has been widely concerned because of its strong ability to solve multi-tasking optimization problems. However, the existing multifactorial evolutionary algorithms still have the problem of lack of transfer way, which will lead to negative transfer phenomenon and reduce the performance of the algorithm. In order to solve this issue, this article proposes multifactorial differential evolution algorithm with intermediate population (MFDE-IP). The intermediate population is obtained by linear weighting of optimal individuals for different tasks. In addition, a new mutation strategy is designed to guide the transfer of the population. The experimental data show that the proposed algorithm has higher convergence accuracy and faster convergence speed.

articleTitle: Structure Optimization Design Based on Armor Cable Automatic Stripping Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In view of the difficulty of wire stripping of armor cable in practical engineering application, an automatic wire stripping machine for armor cable is designed to replace manual work. The successful development of the wire stripping machine can reduce the labor intensity of operators, promote the improvement of work efficiency, reduce the probability of operators being injured, and speed up the construction progress.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Seasonal Microgrid based on ASAGA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at a series of challenges such as energy shortage and environmental pollution, this paper adopts an optimization algorithm based on adaptive simulated annealing genetic algorithm to study the energy scheduling and comprehensive benefits of microgrid under different seasonal meteorological conditions. First of all, the use of a combination of diesel generators and energy storage systems of complementary power generation to deal with the uncertainties of a large number of renewable energy grid. Then, aiming at minimizing economic cost and environmental cost, a multi-objective microgrid optimization model is established. Finally, adaptive simulated annealing genetic algorithm and maximum fuzzy membership principle are used to solve cases under different weather conditions in a certain community. Finally, it is concluded that the adaptive simulated annealing genetic algorithm has faster solving speed and optimization effect than the traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm, which proves the effectiveness of the optimization algorithm. Moreover, the optimal scheduling strategy of microgrid considering seasonality and environmental costs can better dispatch energy under different seasonal meteorological conditions, and improve the comprehensive benefits of microgrid.

articleTitle: Shift Process Analysis of Automatic Transmission Based on Lever Analogy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: this paper presents an approach to improve the lever analogy used in for analyzing automatic transmissions has been perfected and future developed in this paper. More specifically through the analysis of shift process for of automatic transmission with a power split mechanism base on lever analogy, is studied by using the lever analogy of planetary gear-set with power split are given. Analysis and calculation of dynamic torques of all components in shift process are provided from the systematic model. The validity of the lever analogy is verified by analysis of using the testing data from the shift process of a seven-speed automatic transmission.

articleTitle: Research on Low Carbon Economic Operation Model of Distributed Energy Stations Considering Exergy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the promotion of the dual carbon strategy goal, the requirements for energy costs, carbon emissions, and energy utilization efficiency of distributed energy stations are becoming increasingly strict, and there is an urgent need for an economic and low-carbon operation strategy for distributed energy stations. In response to this issue, this article uses the random forest algorithm to analyze the energy consumption characteristics of distributed energy stations, constructs a low-carbon operation model of distributed energy considering exergy efficiency, and verifies its feasibility through simulation experiments. The experimental results show that the proposed method effectively reduces the operating costs and carbon emissions of distributed energy stations, while significantly improving the exergy efficiency of distributed energy stations.

articleTitle: Research on ESPI Image Filtering Method Based on Improved Wavelet Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Electronic Speckle Pattern Interferometry (ESPI) is an optical non-destructive measurement technique. The ESPI streak map contains a large amount of scattering noise, which seriously affects the accuracy of phase information extraction. Aiming at the characteristics of ESPI streak map, this paper proposes an improved wavelet threshold function and adaptive threshold filtering algorithm. The threshold function can effectively overcome the discontinuity and the existence of constant deviation of the hard and soft threshold functions, and the proposed adaptive threshold can effectively inhibit the over-filtering of the effective signal by the traditional fixed threshold. Simulation results show that the improved algorithm improves the peak signal-to-noise ratio by an average of 1.82 dB and the average structural similarity by an average of 11.39% compared with the conventional wavelet hard and soft thresholding method, which can effectively remove the noise of the ESPI image, better retain the fringe detail information of the fringe map, and lay a solid foundation for the subsequent accurate extraction of the skeleton line and phase information.

articleTitle: Design and Control of a Tree Barrier Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor flexibility and inconvenient installation in the process of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) tree barrier cleaning, a new modular tree barrier cleaning robot (TBCR) is proposed. Firstly, the structural design of the new TBCR was carried out based on the modular concept, and the structural characteristics and working principle of the robot were introduced in detail; Then, the position and attitude equations of this robot were established using Newton's theorem of motion and the Euler equation of the rigid body, respectively. Finally, the controller design of this robot was carried out based on the the PID control law, and the trajectory tracking control experiment was carried out. The experimental results show that the designed TBCR has good control accuracy, robustness and tracking effect, which can meet the working needs very well.

articleTitle: Development of GPU-based Parallel CFD Solver for Unstructured Meshes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As computer technology and numerical algorithms rapidly develop, the role of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) in the fields of mechanical and aerospace engineering has become increasingly prominent. However, the outdated hardware level has hindered the application of CFD in both theory and engineering. In this article, we developed a CFD solver based on unstructured grids for compressible hypersonic flow. This solver achieved parallel computing based on GPUs using the CUDA programming model. We optimized the code to cater to the characteristics of CPU/GPU heterogeneous systems. The solver used a second-order finite volume method and an adaptive hybrid Riemann solver to accurately and robustly solve hypersonic flow problems. For grid sizes Up to tens of millions, the solver can achieve two orders of magnitude speedup.

articleTitle: Anomalous Traffic Detection Method for Power Internet of Things Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Edge nodes in power grids typically have lower security capabilities, making important interactions such as power communication more susceptible to potential attack threats. These edge nodes lack strong network protection and security protocols, which can easily become weaknesses in network attacks and increase the risk of power systems. Attackers may use these weak links to invade the power supply chain system, causing adverse effects on power supply and distribution. In order to effectively identify malicious traffic, we propose an anomaly detection method based on attribute graphs to identify potential security vulnerabilities in power IoT traffic. This method utilizes the node representation of the attribute graph to extract features from network traffic, and uses a graph neural network based on meta paths to learn the topological structure and attribute information of the traffic network. In order to ensure the performance of the model in large-scale power IoT nodes, a data accuracy adjustment strategy based on Hoffman encoding was developed to optimize data and adjust the size of attribute maps under different data sizes. The effectiveness of this method was verified through experiments on real network traffic datasets.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Cable-Driven Robot in the Framework of Absolute Node Coordinate Formulation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper presents a dynamic model of a cable-driven robot and investigates the temporal variations in the cable's driving force as the end-effector follows different trajectories. The cable of the cable-driven robot was modeled using the arbitrary Lagrange-Euler absolute node coordinate formulation (ALE-ANCF) beam element, while the end-effector was modeled using absolute nodal coordinate formulation reference node (ANCF-RN). Using the ANCF, the dynamic model of the cable-driven robot was defined in a global coordinate system, making the modeling process highly intuitive. The model is used to calculate the variations in cable driving force over time as the end-effector performs planar and spatial motions. The results indicate that the proposed dynamic model can be effectively used for analyzing both two-dimensional and three-dimensional motions of the cable-driven robot.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Support Based Forgetting Memory Fusion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Under the existing flight test telemetry monitoring system, the fusion processing of multiple sensor parameters in the flight test telemetry data stream can obtain more reliable results than a single sensor, which is conducive to more accurate understanding of the measured object. In order to obtain more reliable flight test data, the grey proximity theory is studied and the exponential decay support function is improved. Based on the improved exponential decay support function, a flight data fusion algorithm is designed to preprocess the multi-sensor data in flight test, obtain the consistency measurement of each sensor at different times according to the support matrix, and introduce the negative correlation between sensor weighting coefficient and time series data variance The forgetting function is set for the positive correlation of the sequence mean to fuse the data. In the existing realtime monitoring system, data fusion module and post-processing module are added, and the accuracy of data is effectively improved by testing the algorithm.

articleTitle: Carbon Flow Calculation Based on BILSTM-Attention Short-Term Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: By integrating short-term load forecasting with carbon flow calculations, we first utilize the BILSTM-Attention short-term load forecasting model to obtain predicted load data for various nodes within the substation area, as well as predicted data for power generation from distributed generation equipment within the substation area. Subsequently, these data are input into the carbon flow calculation model to obtain the next day's carbon emissions data for the substation area. This process can provide essential guidance for power scheduling and user energy consumption within the substation area, ultimately aiding in the reduction of carbon emissions in the substation area.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Firmware Security Detection System Based on Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) era, the number of IoT devices has surged dramatically, leading to a significant increase in corresponding security threats and the emergence of increasingly severe security challenges. In this paper, we introduce a dynamic firmware security detection system based on virtual simulation technology, specifically designed for the automated dynamic analysis of IoT device firmware. The core approach utilizes QEMU simulation technology to create a complete system simulation environment for IoT device firmware. This enables a series of dynamic vulnerability analysis and exploration steps to be conducted on firmware files, all in the absence of the actual hardware environment, thereby facilitating security assessments of device firmware.

articleTitle: Cross-Project Software Defect Prediction with Subdomain Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In recent years, Cross-Project Software Defect Prediction (CPDP) has gained prominence in the field of software engineering. The performance of CPDP is impacted by the variations in feature distributions between source and target projects. Many researches have proposed different method to address this challenge. However, previous studies that employ Domain Adaptation to align the distribution rarely consider the subdomain. To overcome this constraint, we proposed a novel approach called Deep Adversarial Subdomain Adaptation for CPDP. The method consists of four parts: a feature extractor for extracting features from the source and target projects, a classifier for predict the defects, a domain discriminator for predicting domain label and a LMMD module for aligning the subdomain distribution. Our experiments were using AEEEM datasets and the outcomes demonstrate that our method achieves a better performance.

articleTitle: Design of Tunnel Support System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the remarkable advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies across various fields, these tools offer innovative directions for long-standing, experience-based designs in tunnel and underground construction. Especially in the context of vulnerable rock tunnels under high geostress conditions, these technologies have opened up new avenues for research. In such settings, primary support structures frequently experience large-scale deformation due to rock squeezing, subsequently leading to structural failure. To address this issue, we introduce a novel passive deformation node based on the concept of energy release.Initially, we conducted laboratory tests to investigate the mechanical behavior of this new node. A series of rigorous tests were performed to understand its performance under various conditions. Following the lab experiments, field trials were carried out to validate the mechanical properties of this novel node.Ultimately, we employed the PSO-SVM (Particle Swarm Optimization-Support Vector Machine) algorithm to ascertain the data stability of the passive deformation node. The results were then integrated into the tunnel support design, providing further refinement to the support structures and construction plans

articleTitle: Study on RV Transmission Pressure Angle and Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: According to the relative motion relation between cycloid wheel and needle wheel, equations of cycloid wheel tooth profile and RV transmission pressure angle are derived, influence of design parameters such as eccentricity (e), needle tooth distribution circle radius <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(R\mathrm{z})$</tex>, needle tooth radius <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(r\mathrm{z})$</tex> and modification parameters such as isometric shape modification <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\Delta r\mathrm{z})$</tex>, displacement modification <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\Delta Az)$</tex>, angle modification <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\Delta\theta)$</tex> on pressure angle is analysed by matlab program. The result shows that tooth serial number involved in meshing at the same time, single tooth engagement pressure angle and average pressure angle of multi-tooth meshing changes periodically. The mean pressure angle decreases with increasing <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$e$</tex>, increases with increasing <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R\mathrm{z}$</tex> and decreases slightly with increasing <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r\mathrm{z}$</tex>. The influence degree on pressure angle in order from large to small are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$e, R\mathrm{z}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r\mathrm{z}$</tex>. The influence of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta r\mathrm{z}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta R\mathrm{z}$</tex> on pressure angle are slight, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta\theta$</tex> has no influence on pressure angle.
