articleTitle: Smart Agriculture System Based on HarmonyOS
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In response to the extensive management methods of traditional agriculture, it is impossible to achieve precise and intelligent management of agricultural environmental information. This article is based on the Internet of Things architecture and adopts the HarmonyOS distributed operating system unique to Hi3861. It integrates modules such as SHT30 temperature and humidity sensor, BH1750 light sensor, soil humidity sensor, pump motor, fan, etc. for equipment development in the field of smart agriculture. Through the Huawei Cloud platform, real-time monitoring of the agricultural environment and intelligent management of crop growth status can be achieved, improving agricultural production efficiency and management level.

articleTitle: Design and Feasibility Study of PCB Coating Machine Driven by Giant Magnetostrictive Actuator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of unstable coating platform, imprecise spraying and inadequate spraying of conventional circuit board coating machine, a novel conceptual design for a PCB coating machine is proposed. This design is based on the implementation of a giant magnetostrictive actuator. The overview of the conceptual structure and working principle of theis new circuit board coater are introduced. Additionally, a preliminary feasibility study is conducted to evaluate the giant magnetostrictive actuator device of the coating machine. The obtained results demonstrate that the maximum output force of the giant magnetostrictive actuator can reach 53.7N, while the maximum output displacement can achieve 57µm within the applied current range of 0 to 2 A It is observed that both the output force and displacement exhibit a positive correlation with the input current at varying pre-pressures. when the current is between 0.5∼2.0A and the pre-pressure is 0, 100, 200N, the linearity between the output force and the input current is better, These findings validate the excellent controllable performance of the giant magnetostrictive actuator and demonstrate the feasibility of the design of PCB coating processing platform of the utilizing giant magnetostrictive actuator.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband and Inertial-Measurement-Unit Combined Indoor Location Algorithm based on Graph Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Traditional indoor ultra-wideband (UWB) and inertial measurement unit (IMU) combined positioning methods are susceptible to the influence of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) and nonlinear observation model linearization errors. A UWB-IMU combined positioning algorithm based on graph optimization is proposed. Firstly, the IMU velocity information is used to detect the base station in the NLOS environment, then the IMU position information is used to compensate the outliers, and the UWB positioning value is obtained by the least square method, and then the global residual objective function is established. Finally, the Levenberg-Marquardt method based on sliding window is used to obtain the final positioning value. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively identify and reduce the errors caused by NLOS. Compared with KF, the accuracy is improved by 50%, and it has better robustness.

articleTitle: Design of Local Path Planning Algorithm for Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, navigation technology such as positioning, and route planning has become an important research direction in the field of robotics. This paper uses Python, ROS, Gazebo and RVIZ development environments to study the environment simulation and path planning of cleaning robots. We propose a new path optimization method by using dynamic window algorithm and give a concrete implementation scheme. Firstly, Python language is used to verify its effectiveness and feasibility in path planning. Then, the cleaning robot model is built in ROS, and the cleaning robot is equipped with radar and odometer sensors, and the obstacles and emergencies that the cleaning robot may encounter in the real environment are simulated. Finally, through the simulation experiment, it is proved that the path optimization algorithm studied in this paper is feasible and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Chaotic Characterization of a Nonlinear Horizontal Shaker
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To solve the problems such as traditional concrete vibrating table usually can only produce periodic vibration, a nonlinear horizontal vibrating table is designed. The stability of the vibration system is determined by the second Liapunov method and the maximum Liapunov exponent is solved. The dynamical equations are established by using the Lagrange equations of the second type, and the vibration system is recognized as chaotic using MATLAB/simulink., which proves that the vibration system is a chaotic vibration system. The JKR model is established in EDEM and simulation analysis is carried out, which confirms that the nonlinear horizontal vibrating table can better improve the compactness of concrete, and the above findings provide a theoretical basis for the design and optimization of the nonlinear horizontal vibrating table.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Drilling Dynamic of Drilling System of Drilling Robot for Rockburst Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Considering the heterogeneous coal rock conditions and nonlinear characteristics of electrohydraulic drilling system of drilling robot for rockburst prevention, it generates tough challenges of drilling control for developing the borehole drilling efficiency and adaptability. This paper deals with the borehole drilling characteristics analysis of an electrohydraulic drilling system of drilling robot for rockburst prevention. In this study, a drilling dynamic model is constructed for a drilling system that considers the coal rock features and drilling motion characteristic. A drilling control strategy is proposed to develop the borehole efficiency. The results of experiments revealed that the proposed control strategy is more effective within a certain range by changing cutting force. And the tracking error can be controlled in a little range. This study provides a reference for intelligent drilling of drilling robot for rockburst prevention and a method for analyzing the drilling characteristics.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Modeling Approach for Accelerating Dynamics Simulation of Feed Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In the field of CNC machine tools, the feed system typically utilizes servo control for motion control. Throughout the motion control process, the ideal motion control command undergoes correction by the motion controller before reaching the motor controller. Subsequently, the motor controller modulates the motion control command through pulse width modulation to generate pulse signals that regulate the motor. The computational complexity associated with comparator-based digital pulse width modulation techniques poses challenges to the efficiency of dynamic simulations in feed systems. To tackle this challenge, this paper proposes the integration of LSTM neural networks to model the pulse width modulation component of the motor controller, creating a direct mapping between the output of the motion controller and that of the motor controller. This direct mapping relationship significantly reduces the generation time of motor motion commands, thereby enhancing the overall efficiency of dynamic simulations in feed systems.

articleTitle: Research on Bionic Control of Compliant Gait of Multilegged Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The challenge of multi-robot motion control finds effective resolution in Central Pattern Generator (CPG)-inspired gait generation. However, the current research landscape concerning the adjustment of oscillator output curve equilibrium positions is relatively restricted. This paper introduces an external compensation control approach, aiming to procure tailored joint control signals for multi-legged robots. It systematically modulates oscillator output curve equilibrium positions to achieve a diverse array of seamless gaits. The approach involves designing the robot's mechanical structure and establishing its 3D model and coordinate system in Simulink. It utilizes a Hopf oscillator network as the fundamental CPG unit, implementing a CPG circular coupling network controller to streamline oscillator count and establish appropriate initial states. The concept of compliant gait is introduced, along with a qualitative metric to assess smoothness. Comprehensive simulations and analysis validate the effectiveness of this approach in adjusting oscillator output curve equilibrium positions. This study holds both theoretical and practical importance, particularly in enhancing gait control for multilegged robots and advancing biomimetics research.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Virtual Power Plant Considering Wind and Solar Uncertainty and Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at the uncertainty of wind and solar and the realization of low-carbon economic operation of virtual power plant(VPP), this paper establishes a low-carbon economic dispatch model for VPP considering the uncertainty of wind and solar and integrated demand response(IDR), with the objective of minimizing VPP operation costs under the carbon trading mechanism. Firstly, the uncertainty of wind and solar is handled by the methods of opportunity constraints and sequence operation theory(SOT), and the required reserve power of VPP is obtained by setting certain confidence level parameters to ensure the safe and steady operation of VPP. Secondly, a source-load coordinated response mechanism is proposed to enhance the overall flexible operation of the system and further reduce the operating cost of VPP. Finally, the CPLEX solver is invoked to solve the model, and the validity of the proposed model is verified through case simulation.

Author Keywords: the uncertainty of wind and solar

articleTitle: Semantic Enhancement Based Knowledge Graph Completion for Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC) is a task that aims to predict missing links in a knowledge graph based on known triples. Recent studies have demonstrated outstanding performance in KGC employing models grounded on Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN). Nevertheless, prevailing GCN-based models solely utilize neighborhood information of entities to reason, disregarding the textual semantic information of entities and relationships in the knowledge graph. Existing GCN models suffer from poor prediction performance when dealing with tail entities due to limitations. Additionally, these models still have shortcomings in the semantic feature interaction between entities and relations. This paper proposes a Semantic-Enhanced Graph Convolutional Network (SEGCN) for knowledge graph completion. The SEGCN leverages textual descriptions of entities and relations to obtain better entity and relation embeddings using a language model. Additionally, a new Attention-Convolutions Network (ACN) has been developed to enhance the semantic interaction among entities and relations. Based on experimental findings, SEGCN outperforms the state-of-the-art GCN-based model, CompGCN, by showing 0.4%, 0.6%, 0.1 %, and 0.2% improvements in MRR, Hits@l, Hits@3, and Hits@10 on the FB15k-237 dataset, and 1.9%, 1.0%, 2.5%, and 2.9% improvements on the WN18RR dataset, respectively. These findings demonstrate that SEGCN displays improved generalization and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Bolt Positioning Method Using Depth Map and Color Image Fusion from a Depth Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the increasing demand for automated detection of bolt connection parameters in the industrial field, there is an urgent need for the position information of bolts to guide the operation of automated equipment. Therefore, this paper proposes a bolt visual positioning method that combines depth maps and color images. Firstly, outlier points are eliminated from the depth map using histogram analysis. The points of the bolt bottom are projected onto a two-dimensional plane through depth slicing, and the coarse positioning of the bolt is achieved using the Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) algorithm. Then, a circle detection method based on arc-support line segments (ASLS) with pre-processing using bicubic interpolation is applied to detect multiple candidate circles in the color image. Finally, the centroid position obtained from the depth map clustering is combined to obtain the final bolt positioning results. Experimental results show that the bolt spacing absolute error using the proposed method is less than 2.2 mm, validating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Detection Method of Bolt Out-of-Stock Defect in Distribution Network Lines Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: A FCOS detection model for bolt out-of-stock defect detection of distribution network lines with attention mechanism is proposed. The spatial adaptive and size adaptive attention mechanism is mainly used to improve the Head of the original model. While improving the detection accuracy of the model, it also effectively reduces the memory usage and detection time of the model, so that the model can run on the UAV platform and detect the bolt out-of-stock defect target on the distribution network lines efficiently and accurately. Through experimental verification, the method proposed in this paper improves the accuracy of model detection under the premise of effectively reducing the calculation amount of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Location of Distributed Power Distribution Network Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and speed of fault location in distribution networks containing distributed power supplies, this paper proposes an improved binary particle swarm algorithm. A compression factor is introduced to enhance the speed and accuracy of convergence, and the effectiveness of the improved binary particle swarm algorithm is verified through simulation. The simulation results also demonstrate that the improved binary particle swarm algorithm can still accurately locate faults when node information is distorted.

articleTitle: Autonomous Driving and Improved Pure Pursuit Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Autonomous driving is one of the most anticipated technologies of modern times. However, autonomous driving typically relies on high-cost hardware or requires extensive training of today's popular neural network models. The aim of this paper is to enhance and optimize the pure tracking algorithm, for which the selection of the preview distance is crucial. Historically, improvements in preview distance have typically been modeled using linear or non-linear relationships with vehicle speed, followed by the determination of preview distance coefficients. These methods often overlook the impact of actual road conditions on changes in vehicle speed. In this paper, we propose a preview distance function that takes into account real-world downhill situations and incorporates non-linear changes in vehicle speed. This approach achieves a very smooth and precise path tracking performance, both uphill and downhill.

articleTitle: Wind Power Prediction with Ant Colony Algorithm (ACO) Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The development of new energy has been promoted in various countries due to the acceleration of industrialization, the energy crisis, and environmental problems caused by fossil energy. Wind power is a significant source of clean energy and has a considerable share in clean energy power generation. Wind power's randomness, volatility, and intermittency make it a challenging energy source to integrate into power systems, as it can pose a significant threat to the system's stability and reliability. Wind power prediction is crucial to mitigate the impact of wind power uncertainty and increase the utilization rate of wind power. In this study, we focused on the importance of wind power prediction for the stability and reliability of the power system. After analyzing the characteristics of wind power, we proposed using the BP neural network for wind power prediction. To address issues such as random initial weights and thresholds, local minima and slow convergence speed in the BP neural network algorithm, we proposed a method for improving it by using ant colony optimization (ACO) to determine the initial weights and thresholds. Based on this approach, we developed a wind power prediction model that utilizes an ACO-improved BP neural network. Optimizing the neural network control parameters with the ACO algorithm can improve the global convergence performance. A neural network structure for wind power prediction is established by planning and determining the input layer, hidden layer, and output layer in the structure. The results show the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed ACO-based BP neural network algorithm model for wind power prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Objective Optimization Design of Automatic Loading and Unloading Mixer Truck Frame Based on Kriging Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of new rural construction in China, the usage of automatic loading and unloading concrete mixer trucks has been increasing. However, the substantial weight of mixer truck frames negatively impacts manufacturing costs and fuel efficiency. Through a comprehensive analysis of the structural forces on the frame of an automatic loading and unloading concrete mixer truck under four typical working conditions, a multi-objective optimization approach based on the Kriging model is proposed. This approach has been employed to optimize the mixer truck frame, resulting in a weight reduction of 78.4 kg. Validation of the optimized frame's performance was conducted through modal analysis and field testing. The study demonstrates that the integration of surrogate modeling and multi-objective optimization algorithms not only enhances optimization accuracy and efficiency but also ensures that the optimized frame meets usage requirements while achieving a substantial weight reduction. The research accomplishes the dual goals of lightweight design and energy conservation within the context of new rural construction.

articleTitle: An Image Classification Algorithm Based on the Improved FasterNet Model: ARFnet
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Image classification based on deep learning has always been a research hotspot in the field of computer vision, and improving the accurateness of the model is the goal of the majority of scholars to improve the model and innovate the model. In this paper, an improved network model ARFnet (Aspp-Respath-FasterNet) is proposed on the basis of FasterNet. A connectivity module is designed to fuse shallow and deep information at multiple scales. The final training accuracy on the floral dataset can reach 93.2%, and the testing accuracy can reach 85%. Compared with the original network, the accuracy is improved by 9.8% and 1.4%, respectively.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System based on GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a rise in network attack incidents. Efficiently detecting network attack behaviors is crucial for ensuring cybersecurity in resource-limited environments. This paper proposes a lightweight intrusion detection system based on GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit). The system uses information gain and Extra Tree Classifier methods to rank and select important features. Temporal features of network traffic are extracted using gated recurrent neural networks, and classification is performed using the softmax function. To validate its effectiveness, the NSL-KDD dataset is used for evaluation, and experimental results show that the proposed model outperforms other state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Domain Adaptive Based Thrust Prediction Method for Solid Rocket Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The prediction of solid rocket motor performance is crucial for both rocket monitoring and engineering design programs. Accurate thrust prediction significantly enhances rocket reliability and reduces development costs in terms of time and economics. Traditionally, the limited data obtained from solid rocket motor tests poses a challenge in achieving the required prediction accuracy using neural networks. In this paper, we propose a deep learning-based domain adaptive method to address the issue of insufficient sample data in solid rocket motor testing. Our method leverages the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) technique in transfer learning to tackle domain shifting problems. It approximates the distribution of high and low-temperature domains within the feature representation (hidden layer information of the network) learned by the neural network. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method, showing a 6.125% improvement in prediction accuracy over traditional neural networks. This validates the efficacy and superiority of our approach. Hence, our method offers valuable insights into handling small sample data in the field of solid rockets and holds promising applications.

articleTitle: Simulation Implementation of Carbon Dioxide Leakage Source Localization Based on Improved Seeker Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Incidents of harmful gas leaks in the chemical industrial park occur frequently, which seriously endangers people's life. After the occurrence of toxic and harmful gas leakage incidents, environmental departments often face challenges in conducting subsequent emergency response work due to the inability to identify the source of the leaks. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved seeker optimization algorithm (ISOA), based on seeker optimization algorithm (SOA), to locate the gas leakage sources. In the ISOA, an individual stamina model and wind direction guidance are introduced to improve the search step length and direction. The results of simulation experiment demonstrate that the gas leakage source localization method based on the ISOA can locate the contaminated gas leakage source rapidly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Sensorless Vector Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Using High-Frequency Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The vector control system of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM), with its capability for high precision, dynamic performance, and broad speed regulation range, is extensively employed in various domains of motor drive applications. These include electric vehicle traction, propulsion systems of substantial military hardware such as naval vessels, aerospace technologies, and submarines, owing to its exemplary characteristics. Compared to the manufacturing, installation, and maintenance of sensors, the sensorless approach offers benefits such as reduced industrial costs, compactness, and heightened stability. This research delves into the sensorless vector control based on the high-frequency voltage injection method, and a simulation model was developed on the Simulink platform. The model underwent both steady-state and dynamic performance tests, producing simulation waveforms under conditions like noload operation, loaded operation, sudden speed changes, and abrupt load application and removal. The simulation results indicate that this method can effectively detect the rotor's position and speed, demonstrating good stability both statically and dynamically.

articleTitle: A High-Gain Zero-Input Current Ripple Sepic Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: A coupled inductor is added to the input side of the traditional Sepic converter topology, which is connected in series with the inductor and capacitor to form a passive ripple unit. The input current zero ripple effect is realized based on retaining the continuous input current, and the zero-ripple realization is independent of the duty cycle. The double voltage unit structure and the passive clamp absorbing the leakage inductance of loop are added to the output side of the converter, which effectively suppresses the voltage spike and the reverse recovery problem of the diode, reduces the voltage stress of the switch tube and reduces the loss. Finally, a 100 W experimental prototype is built to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Detection of Drainage Well Cover Blockage Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Blockage of manhole covers cannot be detected and dealt with in a timely manner, posing a hidden danger to urban safety. This article focuses on the common problem of blocked drainage well covers in daily life, using machine vision methods to establish a machine vision detection process, in order to provide early warning, timely clean up blockages, and eliminate hidden dangers. The main process includes: data collection, significance detection based on FT algorithm for images, edge detection based on Sobel operator for grayscale images, rectangular calibration for edge detection images, and finally calculating the pixel points in the corresponding grayscale images. Based on the calculation results, the warning level is determined and early warning is given. The method is simple and feasible, and has certain engineering application value.

Author Keywords: Blockage detection of drainage well cover

articleTitle: A Design of Stackable “Single Control Plurality” Satellite Antenna Controller Based on Modularization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: A design approach of stackable modularized antenna controller is proposed demand for multiple satellitebased antennas adjusting directions synchronously or divisionally, which has flexible combination, good interface compatibility and broad prospects. The hardware design method and software information flow realization of the control system are introduced. This system can drive four antennas to track objects in different modes at the same time and the error of control is less than 0.03 degree.

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring of Coal Machine Equipment Based on Self-Powered Sensor System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: A self-powered module, sensor module, transmission module and monitoring host computer are used to construct a monitoring system without external power supply. By collecting the energy generated by the vibration of coal machine equipment, real-time monitoring of the condition of coal machine equipment is realized.

articleTitle: Combination of Disturbance Observer and Sliding Mode Control for Manipulator Trajectory Tracking Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at the susceptibility to external disturbances and inaccurate modelling in the trajectory tracking of manipulator, a control method combining disturbance observer and sliding mode control (DO-SMC) is proposed. Firstly, disturbance is introduced into the manipulator dynamics model derived by the Lagrangian method; secondly, a disturbance observer is designed to equate the disturbances and compensate them to the inputs of the control system; whereas, a sliding-mode variable-structure control with nonlinear sliding surface and improved exponential reaching is designed and Lyapunnov function is used for the stability analysis of the system; finally, simulation experiments are carried out on Matlab/simulink for the end trajectory tracking control of the UR5 manipulator. The experimental results show that the proposed controller can overcome the disturbances and weaken the chattering of system, which improves the stability.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of LLC Resonant Converter Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This article proposes an active disturbance rejection sliding mode control strategy based on improved extended state observer is proposed to address the issue of insufficient output dynamic response in traditional control algorithms for LLC resonant converters. By improving the FAL function of the nonlinear extended state observer, its ability to observe errors is optimized. And the dynamic performance of LLC resonant converters has been improved The simulation experiment shows that the transient response of LLC resonant converter during start-up is consistent with that when using a linear observer. It compensates for the shortcomings of nonlinear observers. When the load current from 0.4A to 2 A. This control method can make the decrease and adjustment time of the system output voltage consistent with when using a nonlinear observer. It compensates for the shortcomings of linear observers.

articleTitle: Workspace Analysis and Simulation of 6-DOF Manipulator Based on DH Parameter Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Taking the 6-degree-of-freedom manipulator as the research object, the kinematics analysis and simulation verification are carried out under specific bar parameters. In order to calculate the working space and pose of the end effector, and the rotation angle of each joint of the end effector under the specified pose, this paper uses the DH parameter method to carry out forward kinematics analysis and inverse kinematics analysis [6]. In order to verify the correctness of the results, the simulation based on Matlab software is carried out, and the Monte Carlo method is used to simulate the working space to verify whether the whole manipulator meets the working requirements [2].

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling of Distributed Agile Satellites
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of task scheduling of distributed agile satellites for Earth observation. The task priority, capability of agile satellites, and data transmission constraints are analyzed. Then the objectives related to observation completion time, profits, and load balance are proposed. Consequently the task scheduling problem is transformed to a multi-constraints multi-objectives optimization problem, which is subsequently solved by contract net protocol (CNP). Three distributed agile satellites and randomly generated 60 target points are used to numerically demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the CNP for solving such problems. Furthermore, the scalability is verified by inserting new tasks into the system on-the-run.

articleTitle: Intelligent Classification of Internet of Things Endpoints and Ontology-Based Security for Multi-Label Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To address the security and manageability challenges posed by the massive influx of heterogeneous IoT terminal devices in emerging power systems, this paper proposes a novel approach for intelligent classification and ontology-based protection. The approach ensures the identification and continuous assessment of the identities of accessing terminals and offers ontology-based protection for IoT terminal devices. Leveraging recent advancements in deep learning techniques, a multi-label classification mechanism is employed to capture the multidimensional features of IoT intelligent terminals awaiting classification, ensuring a high classification accuracy. Based on the classification results, intelligent terminal security information control dimensions are formulated from various security vulnerabilities in aspects including device security, network security, system security, application security, and account security. This enables comprehensive security control over the ontology of IoT devices. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves an identification accuracy of 99.9%, with the added advantages of low cost and low false alarm rates for the multi-label intelligent classification scheme.

articleTitle: A Chinese Sentiment Analysis Model Incorporating Knowledge Graph and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of social media and e-commerce, users are generating large amounts of textual review data on these platforms. Analyzing and mining these comment data is important for governments, enterprises, and consumers to make decisions. Therefore, sentiment analysis, especially for Chinese comments, has become an area of wide interest in industry and academia. Aiming at the characteristics of Chinese online reviews, this paper applies the techniques of knowledge graph and deep learning around sentence-level sentiment analysis and designs a sentiment analysis model that integrates different information such as sentiment knowledge graph and serialized annotation in a deep learning model to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of sentiment analysis of Chinese online reviews. This is important for improving products and services, understanding user needs, and making more informed business and policy decisions.

articleTitle: Adaptive NSGA-II based flexible job shop scheduling with dual resource constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at the multi-objective dual-resource flexible job shop scheduling problem, a model with the optimization objectives of minimizing the maximum completion time, the maximum machine load and the total cost is established, and an improved NSGA-II algorithm with adaptive crossover and mutation operators is proposed. The algorithm firstly designs a hybrid initialization strategy combined with three-stage coding to improve the quality of the initial population; then introduces a hybrid crossover and mutation strategy with adaptive operator to iterate different layers of coding separately to improve the global search capability of the algorithm; finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by example simulation. The results show that the new scheme obtained by using the improved NSGA-II algorithm is significantly improved in terms of maximum completion time, machine load and processing cost, which effectively improves the production management efficiency.

articleTitle: Development and Testing of a Circular Foil Type Heat Flux Density Measurement Device
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: At present, hypersonic aircraft have become a research hotspot in major aerospace countries around the world. During flight, the heat flux of the aircraft is extremely high, and the heat flux changes very quickly. This article starts from the principle of a circular foil type heat flux sensor, analyzes the specific usage environment, installation conditions, and characteristics of the measurement object, and designs a water-cooled heat flux sensor for use in high-temperature and high heat flux environments. The sensor was calibrated using radiation heating and the calibration curve of heat flux/voltage was obtained. The calibration experiment results show that the range of the circular foil heat flux density sensor designed in this paper is 0-1000kW/m2, with a relative error of 2.1%.

articleTitle: High-speed Solenoid Valve Detection System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In view of the problems of complex operation, low efficiency, high load strength, low intelligence of domestic high-speed solenoid valve detection equipment<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1] [2]</sup>, in this thesis, a high-speed solenoid valve detection system based on LabVIEW, using industrial PC, STM32F103 industrial control board, altai series acquisition module, atos digital electronic amplifier, microphone pressure transmitter, flow meter and oscilloscope acquisition card as the main hardware. Using LabVIEW in the G language as a development platform for software algorithms, establish communication between the RS485 bus and the hardware, realize the control of the high-speed solenoid valve, data collection, data analysis and report printing, complete the performance of high speed solenoid valve, to provide reliable technical support for the application of electric power, automobile, aerospace, military industry and other related fields<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup>. The test shows that the system is simple to operate, can efficiently and accurately detect the performance parameters of high-speed solenoid valve, and improve the intelligence of domestic high-speed solenoid valve detection equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mechanical Life and Running State of Electric Turbine Driver Equipment Based on Motor Current Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As an isolated switchgear in KYN switchgear, electric turbine driver equipment still has problems such as low reliability and frequent accidents due to its weak accumulation of electric technology and short promotion and application time. Based on the motor current recording data of electric turbine driver equipment before and after the mechanical life test of circuit breaker handcart, the characteristic parameters such as action time, starting current and energy amplitude are extracted and analyzed. Based on the motor current recording data of electric turbine driver equipment before and after the mechanical life test of circuit breaker handcart, the characteristic parameters such as action time, starting current and energy amplitude are extracted and analyzed.

articleTitle: Improved Local Binary Pattern Based on a Novel Mapping Method for Texture Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Local Binary Pattern (LBP) has received widespread attention since proposed, especially in the fields of texture classification and face recognition. Most of the currently proposed LBP variants are still improved based on the traditional rotation-invariant uniform mapping method (LBP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">riu2</sup>). Nevertheless, LBP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">riu2</sup> loses too much texture information indeed. Inspired by the idea of utilizing complementary information and multi-operator fusion, a new mapping method called Local Binary Pattern Based on Triple Complementary Information (LBP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OUS</sup>) is proposed in this paper. Compared with traditional and latest LBP mapping methods, LBP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OUS</sup> achieves the highest classification accuracy on the Outex and CUReT datasets.

articleTitle: Texture-based Fabric Defect Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a detection method based on textile texture features aimed at achieving surface defect detection in textiles. Firstly, an improved gray-level co-occurrence matrix is used to calculate the statistical texture information of the image, including contrast, dissimilarity, homogeneity, energy, correlation, and ASM. Subsequently, a fully connected neural network model is utilized to recognize and classify the derived texture information. Through a comparison with traditional texture recognition methods, experimental results demonstrate that this method achieves better classification performance. The results indicate that the proposed method achieves a recognition accuracy of 92.5% for fabric defects, which is a 6.5% improvement compared to traditional methods. Furthermore, the use of the improved graylevel co-occurrence matrix enhances the contrast features of image boundaries and enables effective unified calculation of texture statistical information in different areas. The application of this method contributes to practical textile inspection.

articleTitle: Application of High-Precision Spot Center Positioning Algorithm in Settlement Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of construction and infrastructure, traditional settlement monitoring methods have exhibited a significant dependence on manual operation. Therefore, there is an urgent need for high-precision and highly automated settlement monitoring technology in this field. This paper proposes an image-based settlement monitoring method. By utilizing a combination of a laser emitter, target, and camera, we can continuously and in real-time measure the positional changes of the light spot on the target, thereby calculating the settlement amount. This paper elaborates on the centroid localization algorithm for the image-based laser settlement device, as this algorithm ensures the accuracy of settlement monitoring equipment to be within ±0.5mm. The method primarily relies on specific image preprocessing algorithms, noise reduction, and an improved centroid method to determine the light spot's center and perform calculations, ensuring the accuracy and reliability of settlement measurements.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Patrol Robot based on Fusion of Dual LIDAR Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to improve the SLAM problem of inspection robots equipped with LiDAR, an intelligent inspection robot navigation solution based on the ROS platform is developed in this paper, which integrates a single-line and multiline LiDAR. It also provides an intuitive flowchart illustrating the implementation of autonomous navigation functionality. By optimizing point cloud fusion and grid filter, the system achieves synchronized localization and mapping, leading to improved navigation accuracy and enhanced reliability of the environment map. Experimental results validate the feasibility and performance advantages of the system, highlighting its high stability and cost-effectiveness. This research holds reference value and practical significance for the development of patrol robots.

articleTitle: Degradation Prediction of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Considering Distribution Shift
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is one of the most promising energy technologies and has rapidly developed in various fields. However, the limited lifespan of PEMFC hinders its large-scale commercialization. Degradation prediction of PEMFC is critical to predict the degradation trend and prolong its lifespan. This study proposes a data-driven method for multi-step-ahead degradation prediction of PEMFC based on an aging dataset of a stationary PEMFC. The method utilizes the gated recurrent unit (GRU) and Dish-TS adaptive normalization to alleviate temporal distribution shifts. Besides, the Tree-structured Parzen Estimator(TPE) algorithm optimizes GRU's learning rate and network structure. The TPE-Dish-GRU model demonstrated a determination coefficient (R2) of 0.9924, a root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.001, and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.0164 in one-step-ahead prediction. The proposed method with a simple framework outperforms traditional data-driven methods in short-term degradation prediction and has significant value in achieving online health diagnosis of PEMFC.

articleTitle: Visual Inertia SLAM Algorithm for Multi Object Tracking in Dynamic Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The existing visual SLAM algorithms mainly processes dynamic objects by filtering out dynamic regions, and cannot determine the surrounding dynamic objects and their motion information. To this end, a dynamic visual inertia SLAM algorithm is proposed, which can simultaneously track multiple rigid objects in a dynamic environment. Firstly, an instance segmentation algorithm is added to the front end of the algorithm to process the input image to introduce semantic prior information and distinguish between background and object regions. For the object region, a 3D object detection algorithm is used to estimate the 3D bounding box of the object. The object is first associated with the feature points, and then the 2D bounding box of the current frame is associated with the corresponding bounding box of the previous frame. Then, it is associated with the 3D bounding box of the current frame to estimate the object's motion. The backend of the algorithm first optimizes the object's pose within the sliding window, and then performs joint optimization with the camera pose and landmark points. The test results on the dataset KITTI show that our algorithm has excellent performance in tracking 3D rigid objects and has good camera positioning accuracy in complex dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Study on Fluid-Solid Coupling Galloping Characteristics of Overhead Conductors Under Different Icing Forms
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Icing galloping of overhead conductors will lead to wire breakage, fittings wear, and even tower collapse accidents, which may lead to large-scale power outages. In order to study the galloping law of conductors with different icing forms, this paper takes the 110 kV transmission line of Liannan line as the research object. Based on the aerodynamic theory, the analysis model of wind-induced vibration response of conductors with different icing forms is established. The time history analysis of each iced conductor model was carried out by fluid-solid coupling method. The results show that the most galloping wind attack angles of crescent, fan and D-shaped iced conductors are around 20 °, 160 ° and 60 °, respectively. With the increase of icing thickness, the galloping velocity of the conductor decreases significantly. Under the same conditions, the galloping amplitude of crescent-shaped iced conductor is the largest, followed by fan-shaped, and D-shaped is the smallest. When the velocity is small, the galloping amplitude of the conductor increases with the increase of velocity. When the velocity reaches a certain value, the galloping amplitude of the wire decreases with the increase of the velocity. The research results can provide an important reference for the study of icing galloping law of overhead conductors.

articleTitle: Attention-based Mask R-CNN for Microvascular Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The normal functioning of human organs and tissues depends on the spatial organization, specialization, and interaction between cells. With a total of 37 trillion cells in the human body, determining their functions and relationships is highly challenging. The Vascular Coordinate Common Framework (VCCF) is widely used for cell mapping, but it is limited by a lack of knowledge about the microvascular system. Therefore, we propose a novel framework called Attention-based Mask R-CNN for Microvascular Segmentation to achieve automated segmentation of microvascular arrangements. In terms of structure, our model replaces the original fully connected layers with the Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) as the segmentation head network and integrates feature maps from different levels. To enhance performance, we introduce RoI (Region of Interest) feature alignment, employing techniques such as bilinear interpolation to accurately align features within the RoI region. Furthermore, to better focus on the regions of interest, we introduce an attention mechanism specifically designed for Human Vasculature, which improves the segmentation accuracy of critical areas. We train our model using 2D PAS-stained histological images of healthy human kidney tissue sections. Experimental results demonstrate the superior segmentation outcomes of our approach for microvascular structures, including capillaries, arterioles, and venules.

articleTitle: A Pose Control Algorithm for Elbow Models Based on Five-Axis Unsupported 3D Printing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Orthopedic emergency interventions necessitate swift brace production. Utilizing 3D printing technology, expedited fabrication of tailored braces becomes feasible. Nonetheless, the considerable number of suspended structures in elbow braces impedes efficient printing. The five-degree-of-freedom unsupported 3D printing technique, integrated with a rotating base plate, addresses this efficiency concern. Following a field 3D scan, the irregular elbow model's position and orientation must align with the printing mechanism for seamless execution. To tackle the challenge of optimal pose adaptation for the elbow model, a strategy grounded on 3D elbow model characteristics and printing device structural constraints was introduced. Given the non-uniformity of the 3D scanned model, the model's spatial pose attributes were determined by extracting the elbow model's central line, computing the inter-axis angles, and distinguishing between the major and minor axes. Considering the rotation angle restrictions of the printer's base plate and the coordinate placement of the model's foundation point, various aspects of the support model's pose, including its parallel base surface, spatial orientation, and proximity to the base plate, were meticulously calibrated to suit 3D printing requirements. Comparative simulation analyses and print tests confirm the efficacy of the elbow model's automatic adjustment method, advancing the cause of rapid 3D slicing devoid of external support.

articleTitle: The Preparation Method, Resistive Switching Mechanism and Application Prospects of Memristor
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Memristors have also become one of the most promising research hotspots for solving data storage and computing problems faced in the big data era. As an emerging electronic device, memristor has potentially important applications in information storage and processing. This paper constructs a rod-shaped TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>−x nanoscale memristor with FTO/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>−x/Cu structure, whose reliability is based on the memory behavior and its conversion mechanism. Research progress including materials, preparation methods, resistive switching mechanism and application prospects are described. First, the constituent materials of memristor are introduced, focusing on metal oxides and organic materials such as titanium oxide (TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>). The choice of these materials is critical to memristor performance and applications. Secondly, the advantages and limitations of the preparation methods are discussed. Then the resistance switching mechanism of memristor was studied in depth, focusing on the generation principle and adjustment mechanism of memristor effect. These include important concepts such as charge migration, Schottky barrier formation and oxygen vacancy drift, which help to understand the electrical properties of memristors. In addition, we explore the prospects of memristors in practical applications. Finally, past and current work in this field is summarized, and the prospects and challenges of memristorrelated research are prospected.

articleTitle: An Industrial Anomaly Detection Method Based on Spatial Neighborhood Kernel Density Estimation and Feature Sparse Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In recent years, there has been significant development in computer vision technology, which has been implemented in the field of industrial quality inspection with promising outcomes. Industrial image anomaly detection, a crucial research area in computer vision, aims to identify abnormal data that deviates from the expected normal pattern, ensuring the reliable operation of various systems. Therefore, the application of anomaly detection techniques in industrial image anomaly detection and localization has immense significance. This paper presents an unsupervised image anomaly detection algorithm that leverages the spatial and neighboring context information of the image. It employs the kernel density estimation method for non-parametric modeling to estimate the image's normal distribution. Additionally, this paper introduces a sparse representation-based method that employs existing deep network features to reconstruct the image's depth features through sparse expression. By calculating the error in feature computation for abnormal samples during sparse representation, precise pixel-level anomaly scores can be predicted. The proposed method exhibits excellent performance in experiments, achieving an AUROC score of 99.3% in the field of anomaly detection and localization on commonly used benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Research on the Connection Between Electricity Purchasing of Grid Agent and Related Mechanisms in China
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To further promote the market-oriented reform of China's power sector, the state has issued Document No.1439 and Document No.809, which aim to expand the scale of market-based trading of electricity for both generation and consumption. As a result, the mechanism of grid agency purchase of electricity has emerged. However, in the practical implementation of the grid agency purchase mechanism at the provincial level, there are issues such as unclear order of electricity matching and unclear cost structure. This article analysis and summarizes the background of the grid agency purchase mechanism and its current implementation status. It also conducts research on key issues in the connection between grid agency purchase of electricity and related mechanisms. Through case study, it provides theoretical and data foundations for the improvement and promotion of the grid agency purchase mechanism.

articleTitle: Pro-Authentication Anomaly Detection Solution Based on Raw Key and Mouse Behavior Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As the first layer of security for computer systems, authentication technology plays a pivotal role in protecting users’ personal information. However, the behavior anomaly of the login user after authentication should be detected because the cryptographic credentials may be leaked. Currently, behavior anomaly detection without the user's awareness is made possible by detection methods based on keystroke and mouse behaviors, which is a hot research area right now. However, the data sets of existing schemes often impose different degrees of limitations, and the identification capability needs to be improved. In this paper, we describe a scheme based on the fusion of keystroke and mouse behavior features to detect anomaly of login user, and collect data sets in the user's natural working environment without any restrictions. Inspired by image recognition, we first map the raw data to grey-scale images and then use convolutional neural networks to extract deep features from the images. Detection results of 0.990 accuracy were obtained when the input image size was 64 × 64 in size. The paper also investigates the effect of adding window features to keystroke behaviors on the detection performance.

articleTitle: Development and Evaluation of Mechanical Harvesting of Root Crops and its Performance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Root crops grow in the soil deeply and bond with soil closely, which results in that the process of the separation between soil and root becomes the most difficult during the harvesting processes. In order to harvest root crops efficiently, the mechanical harvesting has become the main developing trend. However, high power and high damage rate are still occurred when mechanical harvester gets in touch with the roots. In this paper, we review the research of the development and evaluation of the mechanical harvesting of root crops and its performance optimization on the past years. The process of soil separation mainly consists in the first separation between root and the ground and further separation between root and adhered soil. In general, the soil-cutting operation in the initial separation and the sieving mechanism in the further separation require high draught and power. And the dramatic friction, impact, pressure and so on, which happen in the components and soil-roots, are the key reasons to lead to root damage. The optimization of harvesting methods and parameters, including the digging shovel shape, working conditions, vibration, and screening way, is more significant in improving the harvesting performance. But there are still some limitations in the research and application of the mechanical harvester for root crops. Future research is suggested to focus on the development of the soil break-up when the digging shovel cutting soil, the insight into the interaction between soil and roots by different external compression loads, and the long-term studies to verify the high-efficiency and low-damage performances of mechanical harvester in practical application.

articleTitle: Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Attention Mechanism and Multi-Channel Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: A neural network model based on convolutional attention mechanism (CBAM) multi-channel processing was studied for the fault diagnosis of rolling bearings under noisy actual working conditions in the attitude adjustment mechanism of a certain missile assembly and docking equipment. The model firstly carries out feature extraction through the first layer wide convolutional kernel, which enhances the robustness of the model and maintains the characteristics of the temporal sequence signal; the two channels adopt the improved first layer wide convolutional kernel deep convolutional network (IWDCNN) and the long-short-term memory neural network (LSTM), which combines the advantages of both of them in order to maximize the effect of the convolutional network in extracting the features; using the attention mechanism to adaptively assign weights to each of the features of the two channels, in order to enhance the effectiveness of the feature extraction. The attention mechanism is used to adaptively assign the weights to each feature of the two channels, which enhances the effective features while suppressing the influence of the invalid features on the prediction results of the model. Through comparative experiments, the results show that the model has higher classification accuracy and better training efficiency under noisy data.

Author Keywords: Long and short-term memory neural networks

articleTitle: Application of Heterogeneous Clustering Routing Algorithm based on Interval II TSK Fuzzy System in Voice Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Wireless sensor network is an important means for human data collection and environmental monitoring, and there are problems such as large cluster head selection cost, unbalanced node energy consumption, and short network life cycle in large-scale voice wireless sensor network. Based on this, a non-uniform clustering routing protocol based on interval II TSK fuzzy system is proposed. On the basis of the traditional protocol, the interval boundary of the membership degree is set for the determinants Ei, Ni and Pi of the average energy formula of network nodes, and the network clustering is optimized. In the scheduling process, the time slot is used for data collection, and the dimensionality reduction operation is used to improve the data transmission efficiency. With the help of fuzzy model, the competitive radius and cluster head level decisions are optimized, which effectively reduces the network energy overhead and achieves the purpose of energy consumption balance. Finally, on the MATLAB platform, the network clustering, average node energy consumption, node survival number and other indicators are better than other algorithms, and the simulation verifies that the design scheme can effectively balance the energy consumption of nodes and extend the life cycle of the entire network

articleTitle: Optimum Design and Thermal Analysis of Built-in Fractional Groove Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In view of the requirement of a wide speed range of motor spindle motor, the built-in permanent magnet motor is selected to optimize the design, and the problems of high loss and low efficiency of the built-in permanent magnet synchronous motor are discussed and optimized. The motor optimization design was carried out for the four types of permanent magnet structures: non-segmented permanent magnet, two-segment permanent magnet, three-segment permanent magnet, and foursegment permanent magnet. The motor's finite element electromagnetic field simulation model was established, and the theoretical loss calculation was carried out for the motor structures with different segments of the permanent magnet. Through the coupling simulation analysis of electromagnetic and temperature field, the temperature rise and distribution of each component of the motor with four different segments of permanent magnets are obtained. Through theoretical analysis and prototype experiment verification, compared with the traditional built-in one-line motor, the built-in segmented fractional slot permanent magnet synchronous motor designed in this paper can reduce the machine loss to 43% of the original, and the overall performance of the prototype meets the requirements, the prototype design and test can provide a certain basis for the design of spindle motor.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Networking Method of 5G Slicing and WiFi6 in Substation Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper presents a collaborative networking approach for 5G slicing and WiFi6 in the context of substations. Based on a new switching algorithm of fuzzy logic, it first proposes a speed-adaptive network discovery method, which can automatically adjust the update frequency of the candidate network according to different speeds of mobile terminals, then proposes a pre-judgment mechanism for fast filtering out the candidate network; then describes the switching decision based on fuzzy logic to determine the optimal network and whether to switch. Finally, it describes the switching execution process in the heterogeneous environment of LET network and WIFI network. The method introduces a software architecture for key network elements and mechanisms for network enhancement, optimizing the energy efficiency of both the information and communication systems within the power grid. This optimization leads to an improved service quality in substations. By integrating WiFi terminal access into the 5G private network, the proposed approach achieves unified authentication, management, and rapid service provisioning for wireless local area network (WLAN) users without native 5G capabilities. This integration enhances mobility support for substations. Simultaneously, the method significantly enhances the uplink bandwidth while reducing network deployment and terminal retrofitting costs within substations. This approach facilitates high-speed and stable network connectivity for substations, supporting various applications such as realtime monitoring, data transmission, remote maintenance, and intelligent device management. Consequently, this advancement is anticipated to enhance the efficiency, reliability, and security of substations.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Matching the Muzzle Brake and Buffer Device on the Muzzle Disturbance of a Special Firearm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In order to study the impact of matching the muzzle brake and buffer device on the muzzle disturbance of a special firearm, this paper takes a special firearm as the research object, and based on the research method of rigid-flexible coupling dynamics, with the platform for fixing the firearm as the flexible body. ADAMS dynamic software is used to conduct simulation. The research plan includes the presence or absence of muzzle brakes, the presence or absence of buffering devices, buffering devices with different parameters, and the coordination between buffering devices with different parameters and muzzle brakes. The dynamic simulations and analyses for the aforementioned working conditions were proceeded respectively. By comparing the laws and differences from the simulation results, the optimal scheme which presents the minimum disturbance of the special firearm muzzle was determined. The research results indicate that the combined effect of muzzle brake and buffer device has a significant effect on reducing muzzle disturbance, and the combined effect of the two is better than the effect of their respective individual use.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Strategy of Wind-Photo Voltaic-Storage Generation System Based on Chaotic-Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As the penetration rate of renewable energy increasing, the situation of new electric power system is now multiply. In order to improve power quality and supply reliability, the wind-photovoltaic-storage complementary power generation system should be effectively scheduled. In this paper, the scheduling strategy is firstly formulated with the aim as minimizing the cost of wind-photovoltaic-storage complementary power generation system. In the meanwhile, a mathematical model is established according to the strategy, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) is applied to the model. Secondly, the PSO is improved from the aspects of initialization and adaptive algorithm parameters to improve its operation accuracy and reduce the probability of falling into local deadlock. Finally, combined with the actual data of cloudy days in winter, PSO and improved PSO are respectively used in the simulation software to solve the scheduling model, and the results are compared and analyzed, so as to achieve the optimal economy of the system.

articleTitle: Changes Detection of Retinal Diabetic Retinopathy Based on Fundus Images Registration
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In clinical diagnostics, monitoring the progress of patient treatment and the evolution of medical conditions often involves comparing two retinal fundus images of the same eye, taken before and after treatment, to detect areas of change. This comparison provides valuable insights to assist healthcare professionals in their treatment analysis. Therefore, the change detection of retinal images is a critical area of research. The detection of anatomical structures in retinal images with pathological lesions is often challenging, primarily due to the interference caused by these lesions. Additionally, it can be affected by factors such as variations in the patient's perspective and lighting conditions. To address these issues, the study proposes a method for the detection of structures and the identification of pathological changes in retinal fundus images. This method is based on the RegPA deep learning network, which is applied after image registration. We introduce a lightweight retinal image registration method, RegPA, based on deep learning. Following precise image registration, we apply an adaptive thresholding method to the difference images of the current image pairs to mitigate the impact of varying illumination. This approach dynamically determines threshold values for each pixel, accommodating variations in brightness across different regions of the image and effectively identifying the desired areas of change. Experimental results confirm the robustness of our algorithm, particularly when evaluated on the Messidor dataset.

articleTitle: Overview of Abnormal Sound Detection for Hydroelectric Generating Units
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The proper operation of hydroelectric generating units, one of the core pieces of equipment in a hydroelectric plant, is critical to the safe and stable operation of the plant. Abnormal sound detection in the power plant could prevent accidents, improve efficiency, save costs and ensure the safety of personnel. Thus, hydropower plants should attach great importance to abnormal sound detection, strengthen equipment maintenance management to ensure safe and stable production operation. At present, the sound detection system in hydropower plants is mainly used to monitor the operating status of equipment such as hydraulic turbines, generators, bearings, gears and pumps. These devices produce sounds of various frequencies and amplitudes during operation, and the system can analyse the characteristics of these sounds to determine whether the equipment is operating normally. Abnormal sounds are usually caused by equipment failure or damage, such as turbine blade damage, bearing wear, poor gear mesh, etc. These abnormal sounds are usually different from the sound characteristics of the equipment during normal operation and can be identified and monitored by the sound detection system. Abnormal sound detection technology mainly includes the following steps, i.e., sound signal acquisition, signal preprocessing, feature extraction and fault diagnosis. Among them, feature extraction is the core of abnormal sound detection. By extracting and analyzing the spectrum, waveform, energy and other features of the sound signal, it can determine whether there is abnormal sound in the equipment. This technology has been widely used in the production practice of hydroelectric power plants and has the advantages of high reliability, high detection accuracy and high realtime performance. The main purpose of this paper is to give a brief overview of abnormal sound detection technology for hydroelectric generating units, discuss and summary the latest researches.

articleTitle: Diagonal Recurrent Neural Network Control of Active Magnetic Bearing Based on Multi-Physics Field Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Multi-physical field factors impact the dynamic modeling of active magnetic bearings (AMBs), a crucial concern in the control of AMBs. In this paper, the focus is on modeling the thermal, electromagnetic, fluid, and structural multi-physics field dynamics of the AMB-rotor. A virtual prototype model (VPM) based on this coupling is proposed, and neural network control of Diagonal Recurrent Neural Network (DRNN) is utilized to address the nonlinear and multi-physics field issues of the AMB-rotor system. This approach effectively achieves system torque decoupling. Finally, the effectiveness of the control algorithm, along with the accuracy and reliability of the multi-physical field coupled VPM, is verified through comparative simulations and experiments of the PID controller and the DRNN controller.
